title: Creative Director
description:
**About Us**
There’s a reason HUNTER is recognized as a PRWeek Best Place To Work and has been named PRovoke “Consumer Agency of the Year” not once, but twice: At HUNTER, we EARN IT — consumer attention, the trust and loyalty of clients, and the dedication of our staff, currently 350+ strong and counting.
  
  
**Overview**
The Creative Director is a proven creative leader who consistently develops disruptive, culture-shaping ideas that cut through and drive earned-worthy moments for clients. Leading an integrated Art and Copy team, you bring both conceptual rigor and the self-editing skills to shape campaigns with minimal oversight. You thrive as a hands-on creative, formulating bold ideas on brief, directing executions, and presenting directly to clients with confidence and clarity. As an emerging leader, you mentor and elevate your team while demonstrating the creative maturity and strategic thinking that positions you as the next generation of creative leadership at HUNTER.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Creative Leadership & Idea Development**

* Lead and own creative work across assigned accounts, consistently and independently generating a high volume of original, disruptive ideas grounded in strategy and on brief
* Develop compelling creative concepts that align with HUNTER client objectives and measurable KPIs; demonstrate strong self-editing skills to shape ideas into award-worthy, culture-disrupting campaigns
* Translate complex briefs and strategy into clear creative direction; understand and appreciate the importance of strategy and ensure all ideas ladder to client business objectives
* Lead creative concepting, brainstorms, and strategy sessions with energy and conviction, fostering bold thinking and pushing boundaries within strategic intent
* Concept and direct across disciplines; developing storyboards, comps, copy, and integrated executions that showcase creative excellence
* Deliver compelling pitch presentations and new business concepts; serve as a confident external-facing creative voice for HUNTER when needed
* Review all work with ECD and Sr. Integrated Creative Director to ensure alignment and creative excellence before presenting to internal account and client teams
* Lead the charge for Creative Exploration across the agency by leading Creative Competitions, hack-a-thons and open calls for ideas to help get the best creative thinking available in the agency.

**Creative Direction & Execution**

* Establish strong visual & copy direction and creative standards for assigned work, guiding Art Directors, Copywriters, Designers and Producers toward executions that match creative intent
* Demonstrate strong conceptual design thinking and creative strategy skills; collaborate with design, experiential and production teams to ensure visual storytelling is compelling and on brand
* Demonstrate strong conceptual writing skills paired with strategic thinking; ability to articulate ideas with precision and clarity
* Provide precise, actionable feedback that elevates creative work across ideation, design, and visual execution
* Ensure executions are delivered on time and on budget, with quality matching or exceeding creative vision
* Work seamlessly with Creative Production Leads to handle all production and post-production across design, video, and experiences
* Support the integration of emerging tools and AI into creative workflows, leveraging technology to enhance ideation and execution without compromising craft

**Team Leadership & Mentorship**

* Lead, inspire, and mentor an integrated Art and Copy team, setting clear expectations and providing regular coaching, feedback, and professional development support
* Mentor Copywriters, Art Directors and Designers at various levels, elevating their thinking, strengthening their craft, and growing the next generation of creative leaders
* Model creative leadership through clear direction, decisive creative judgment, strong taste, and empowerment of individual contributors
* Foster a collaborative team culture where bold ideas are encouraged, feedback is constructive and respectful, and exceptional work is celebrated
* Conduct project-based performance feedback and contribute to formal performance review processes; support career development and growth
* Demonstrate maturity in navigating challenging client situations, finding creative opportunities even within difficult constraints
* Collaborate with flexibility and confidence to build account team and client trust and ensure satisfaction while maintaining HUNTER's creative standards
* Identify growth opportunities with existing clients; support account expansion through strong creative work and strategic thinking

**New Business & Agency Growth**

* Support HUNTER’s new business initiatives by developing concepting and pitch presentations that showcase HUNTER's creative capabilities
* Bring thoughtful, fresh, and strategic ideas to new business opportunities; demonstrate the energy and enthusiasm that wins pitches
* Contribute to agency marketing and thought leadership by sharing strong work and participating in industry conversations

**Budgeting and Finance**

* Track team members hours/rates and OOP costs against budget and work with the ECD to manage billability and useability across the team
* Establish a clear line of communication with account teams, ECD and COO with respect to scoping and pricing models for all projects
* Work with account/HR/Finance team on all vendor agreements, ensuring competitive bids are met and costs are appropriate for the size and scale of the project
* Manage all vendor contracts, and insurance (both freelance and production vendor)

**Qualifications**

* 6-10+ years of creative leadership, with proven success leading multidisciplinary teams in integrated marketing, brand experiences, or communications
* Exceptional portfolio demonstrating conceptual strength, visual storytelling, and integrated campaign execution
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute innovative campaigns that drive engagement and measurable results
* Record of winning new business and expanding existing client relationships

**Leadership & People Skills**

* Ability to mentor, coach, and develop creative talent; model strong leadership through clear direction, constructive feedback, and empowerment
* Proven experience managing and inspiring cross-functional teams across design, content strategy, production, and account management
* Strong communication and presentation skills; confidence when presenting to clients, stakeholders, and executive leadership
* Sharp collaboration and active listening skills, with the ability to align teams and stakeholders around shared vision

**Strategic & Operational Mindset**

* Strong strategic thinking: ability to dissect briefs, uncover insights, and translate business objectives into compelling creative solutions
* Hands-on expertise overseeing multiple complex projects at various stages while maintaining high-level strategic oversight
* Experience managing budgets, resources, and freelance partnerships; commitment to executing projects efficiently and profitably
* Comfort working in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments
* A good understanding of working with vendors, materials costs, freelance costs, printing and pricing and the ability to reach agreements that are fair and/or favorable to the agency

**Cultural & Technical Awareness**

* Cultural curiosity and awareness; ability to create ideas that resonate with diverse audiences and communities
* Knowledge of design, production, emerging technologies, and their application to earned, marketing and experiential work
* Strong understanding of social media and digital integration; ability to amplify activations through strategic content and storytelling
* Genuine interest in AI, automation, and emerging tools; eagerness to explore and implement technologies that strengthen creative output

**Compensation**
In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, the Company believes the target range of base compensation for this role is $150,000 - $175,000. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.
  
  
At HUNTER, we work hard and play hard, and while we have all the benefits you’d expect —competitive health and dental insurance plans, a 401K company match and generous PTO — we also provide:
  
  

* a hybrid work model;
* a “work from anywhere in the US” policy (up to four weeks a year);
* a year-round staff training and development curriculum; and
* a staff-led Action Group dedicated to DEI excellence in the agency and industry (read our DEI statement here: https://hunterpr.com/dei/ )

Perks? We have perks. When you work at HUNTER, you can expect Bring Your Parents (And Kids) to Work Days, regular volunteer Days of Service, mid-day Cupcakes and Cocktails mixers and epic Halloween and holiday parties.
  
  
Founded in 1989, HUNTER has grown into one of the most respected mid-size marketing communications firms in the country, creating work that matters in strategic planning, earned media relations, social and digital media, talent and influencer engagement, experiential marketing, multicultural outreach and content creation and distribution. And we do it all for esteemed companies and brands across every sector you can imagine:
  
  

* Food + Beverage
* Wine + Spirits
* Health + Wellness
* Beauty + Personal Care + Fashion
* Home + Lifestyle + Travel
* Retail + E-commerce

See us in action here: https://hunterpr.com

title: Creative Director
description:
The Creative Director is the face of creative on their accounts. They lead concept development and the campaigns that grow out of it. On some of that work, they execute hands-on at a senior level. For the rest, they manage and develop the creative team producing it. They immerse themselves in their clients' businesses, technologies, and markets deeply enough to own the work and the relationship, and they hold the line on quality whether the work is theirs or the team's.

**Who You Are:**
================

* A creative leader who owns the work on your accounts, directing the team's output and holding the standard on everything that reaches a client.
* Still hands-on in the craft, executing at a senior level on the work that calls for it, and setting the bar by what you make as much as what you direct.
* Able to take a complex B2B business and find the idea that makes it land with real people, then sell it in the room.
* A developer of people, giving direct feedback, creating real opportunities, and taking your team's growth personally.
* Commercially sharp, running creative on your accounts profitably and building client relationships that grow.
* Ahead of the problem, whether that's work drifting off strategy, a team stretched too thin, or a client losing confidence.

**Key Responsibilities:**
=========================

Creative Direction & Craft

* Execute at a senior level on a subset of client work, from concept through production-ready files, taking on the projects that most need your hands.
* Lead the development and presentation of campaign concepts and key creative executions on your accounts.
* Deliver creative that meets clients' marketing and communications objectives, not just their aesthetic preferences.
* Write and present persuasive rationales for campaign approaches and defend the work in the room.
* Own brand consistency and unification across everything your accounts produce.
* Set the visual direction on your accounts, making the calls on typography, color, imagery, and how a piece moves the eye, and giving designers and art directors what they need to execute it.
* Make sure art and copy work together from concept through execution.

Team Leadership

* Manage and develop art directors, designers, and writers on your accounts, owning the quality of their work.
* Direct and review creative before it reaches clients, giving the feedback that makes the work and the person better.
* Own your direct reports' development through regular one-on-ones, growth plans, and stretch assignments.
* Lead critiques, ideation sessions, and creative reviews that raise what the team believes is possible.
* Balance assignments and capacity across your accounts and get ahead of workload risk before it reaches clients.
* Run creative on your accounts efficiently and profitably, working with project management on scope, resourcing, and timelines.

Account & Agency Partnership

* Serve as a core team member on your accounts alongside account, strategy, and channel leads.
* Immerse yourself in your clients' business, technology, products, and markets, and keep that knowledge current.
* Partner with strategy so creative is built on insight rather than assumption.
* Bring creative thinking to growth conversations and contribute to new business where your accounts or expertise fit.
* Keep the VP of Creative and account leadership informed on creative health, client relationships, and anything that could turn.

AI Leadership

* Identify workflows and task types across your team that could benefit from new AI tools or approaches.
* Test and pilot new tools, evaluating quality before recommending broader use.
* Support your team in applying approved tools appropriately, including where a tool should and shouldn't be used, and make sure they have the training and guidance.
* Reinforce Godfrey's AI usage policies and guidelines, and the expectation that AI output gets reviewed for quality, accuracy, and originality before it's relied on or shared.
* Surface promising tools, risks, and adoption concerns to the VP of Creative.

**Qualifications:**
===================

* Extensive agency creative experience, including leading campaign concepting and execution across print, digital, and web. B2B experience preferred.
* Experience managing and developing creative talent, including art directors, designers, and writers.
* Proven ability to judge concepts, art, and copy, give direction that makes the work better, and execute at a senior level yourself.
* Strong command of marketing principles and how creative connects to client business objectives.
* Experience presenting and selling creative work to client leadership.
* Digital and content fluency, including how creative performs across channels.
* Experience running creative profitably, including scope, resourcing, and timelines.
* Experience evaluating or rolling out tools and workflows across a team, including AI.
* Portfolio showing range, craft, and ideas that moved client businesses.

At Godfrey, we are guided by 5 core values that all team members are expected to embrace: Fascination, Drive, Partnership, Transparency and Community. By following these principles, we have become the driving force behind many B2B brands’ success stories.

title: Associate Creative Director (Freelance)
description:
### **Experience Without Limits** **Come shape the future of brand experience.**

**At Jack Morton, we design and build**head-turning, smile-inducing, impact-driving brand experiences that redefine what experiential marketing can achieve. We help our clients **unlock the full value of experiences** by turning bold ideas into meaningful connections.

**That takes a team that's bold, curious, and acts as one.** We build on each other's ideas, challenge conventions, and show up for one another every day. Here, you'll do your best work, grow quickly, and partner across clients, disciplines, and global teams to bring new ideas to life.

This is a place where curiosity drives what's next, boldness raises the bar, and every win is shared. Where ownership is expected, egos are left at the door, and the work reflects the passion and talent of the people behind it.

Experience without limits—in your work, your growth, and your impact.

**Associate Creative Director - Freelance**
-------------------------------------------

* This is a freelance position, starting at 20 hours/wk through November 2026 and flexing up to 32hrs/wk, from November 2026 – May 2027.

* Compensation range for this role is $95-110/hr, commensurate with experience.

\*\*Applicants MUST submit a link to a portfolio of work (and password if applicable) for consideration\*\*

As an Associate Creative Director, you will develop winning creative solutions that deliver client satisfaction and meet the financial and business objectives of Jack Morton. You will work across a portfolio of B2C & B2B clients that spans industries from integrated experiences, digital media, and content programs with the potential to expand into live events. You will focus on developing solutions that drive audience engagement and communicate client messages. The range of your communication solutions may include digital interactive, video, live presentations, social media, web, display technology and other strategies.

We are looking for a hands-on, digital-minded Associate Creative Director with a background in copy or design, and experience leading creative and design teams. You have a strong POV and are accountable for generating big, brave, bold creative ideas and making these ideas come to life (about 25% concepting, 75% execution). Your primary client is a research-driven account, and you'll be responsible for digesting and distilling key concepts via different forms of content and conversations with subject matter experts. You'll report directly to the VP, Executive Creative Director.

### **What you'll be doing:**

* **Brand Expert:** Skilled at mastering complex technical topics for diverse B2B and B2C audiences, pushing creative design boundaries, and connecting with unique audiences in unexpected ways.
* **Digital-first Mindset:** Proficient in crafting campaigns around digital assets (web banners, websites, social media, etc.) and spaces alongside web design and UX/strategy, while overseeing junior and freelance staff to ensure brand consistency and quality.
* **Insight-Driven & Measurable:** Be an expert in the strategy as outlined in the brief - able to provide strategic rationale for creative choices to give the work meaning and produce measurable results.
* Generating big creative ideas to address clients' business needs that are rooted in fresh brand, product, and audience insights.
* From draft to delivery, you are hands-on designing and executing big ideas.
* Participating in the development of the creative brief and partnering with the strategy team to ensure the work delivers on the brief.
* Presenting your ideas in a compelling way to internal audiences and clients.
* Helping to build the agency's reputation, profile and relationships with talent and clients.
* Collaborating across the worldwide agency's community of creative, strategy, growth, and operations colleagues to share ideas, resources, and best practices.
* Directing the creatives on your project teams and adding to the team culture.
* Foster a diverse, equitable, and inclusive team environment where different perspectives strengthen the work and different working styles are supported

### **What you will bring:**

* 5+ years of overall creative experience preferably at a brand or ideas-driven agency.
* Bachelors degree, preferably in communications, graphic design, digital media or related areas of study.
* Proven track record of delivering effective and outstanding creative work
* A background in copy or graphic design will be accepted.
* Experience with integrated marketing, media and digital communications campaigns preferred. Events or exhibits creative experience is a plus!
* Expertise in Microsoft PowerPoint; proficiency in Figma, and for candidates with design backgrounds, proficiency in the Adobe Creative Suite.
* Ample hands-on work experience (you are a "do-er") coupled with some management experience (you can lead a team - formally or informally).
* Engaging presentation skills and a track record of successfully selling and executing strategic creative ideas
* An unwavering curiosity for creative and cultural innovation

Last but not least, we believe in diversity, equity and inclusion. Jack Morton is an equal opportunity employer; we strongly value diversity at our companies. We do not discriminate on race, religion, color, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

*We make our careers website accessible to any and all users. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at* *jobaccomodations@jackmorton.com.* *This email address is not for general employment inquiries or vendors; rather it is strictly for applicants who require special assistance accessing our employment website. Due to volume, messages sent to this email address that are not related to an accommodation cannot be answered.*

title: Art Director
description:
**ABOUT GMR MARKETING**

**We are** ***the*** **Experience Agency Making Unforgettable Stories Born of Humanity**

**NOT JUST EXPERIENTIAL.** ***EXPERIENCE.***

The lines have blurred. People live in the physical, digital, and social worlds all at once, and your brand experiences should do the same.

**NOT JUST TELLING.** ***MAKING.***

The best stories are lived, not heard. Make an immersive world for people to explore so they can experience something they'll never forget.

**NOT JUST CONSUMERS.** ***HUMANS.***

It all starts with the human. If you want to make a lasting impact, look beyond the wallet to understand what motivates and inspires people.

You see ideas visually. You understand that great art direction is about more than making something look good. It's about creating a distinct point of view, building an aesthetic language, and knowing how every image, composition, detail, and decision works together to tell a story. You can take a concept from an early sketch or instinct and turn it into a visual world that people can see, feel, and connect with.

You're not just executing a creative direction. You're a creative partner who helps shape the idea from the start. You know when to push a concept further, when to challenge what is expected, and how to translate an idea across 2D, 3D, physical, and digital spaces. You can art direct a shoot, build a presentation that brings a concept to life, and give a team the clarity and confidence to see the vision.

Your visual thinking helps shape more than individual pieces. It helps shape entire campaigns. You'll work alongside Creative Directors, Design Directors, and strategists, bringing your perspective to the table and helping establish the aesthetic direction from the beginning. You'll also mentor emerging talent, sharing your perspective and helping others develop their own visual instincts. You're curious enough to explore what's next, confident enough to lead the vision, and thoughtful enough to know that great art direction lives in both the big idea and every detail that brings it to life.

***A portfolio or work samples are required to be considered for the role.***

***Candidates must be comfortable supporting a tobacco client.***

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

* **Set the visual standard.** You'll shape the aesthetic direction for major projects, establishing the visual language, mood, and point of view that everything else builds from. You know how to take a brief and turn it into a visual world that feels distinctive, considered, and ownable across campaigns and brand touch points.
* **See the whole picture.** You move naturally between 2D, 3D, experiential, digital, and physical spaces, finding the right visual expression for an idea. You understand how individual images, compositions, materials, and details come together to create a larger brand experience.
* **Make ideas visible.** You're an exceptional visual thinker who can sketch, collage, build mood boards, and use AI imagery to explore ideas quickly. You know how to develop those early explorations into polished presentation materials and visual systems that make a concept clear, compelling, and easy to believe in.
* **Bring the vision to life.** You have experience art directing photoshoots and video production at a high level, from pre-production through final delivery. You understand how to make thoughtful decisions around composition, lighting, styling, casting, location, and production while keeping the larger creative vision intact.
* **Shape the work, not just the execution.** You'll partner with Creative Directors, Design Directors, and strategists. Sometimes you'll translate an existing vision. Other times, you'll help define it. You bring a strong point of view, ask the right questions, and know when pushing an idea further will make the work better.
* **Make good ideas better.** You'll develop visual systems that give teams a clear creative foundation, from palettes and compositions to imagery and aesthetic principles. You know how to create consistency without sacrificing personality, and you're comfortable working from the big picture down to the smallest detail.
* **Lead & inspire.** Set the bar for excellence and create a collaborative environment where creativity thrives. You inspire, motivate, and challenge your team to consistently deliver exceptional work, while providing clear, direct, real-time feedback that helps people grow not just improve the work in front of them.
* **Present with clarity and conviction.** You can lead a client through a creative idea, explain why the visual choices matter, and make a compelling case for the work. You bring both strategic thinking and artistic confidence to the room.
* **Bring the craft and experience.** You have professional art direction experience in an agency, production, or integrated creative environment, expert level sketching and rapid visualization skills, and mastery of Adobe Creative Suite including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and Acrobat. You're curious about emerging tools and technologies and know how to use them to make the work more ambitious, not simply faster.
* **Bring a point of view.** Your portfolio shows aesthetic authority, diverse project experience, exceptional craft, and work produced at scale. More than anything, it shows that you can set a standard, lead a visual vision, and create work that people remember.

*The annual range for this role varies between $80,000- $95,000 and may vary depending on the candidate's experience. Benefits for this role include health/vision/dental insurance, 401k, employee stock purchase plan, vacation, personal days and paid holiday time. You are also eligible to participate in disability, life insurance, FSA/HSA plans subject to the terms and conditions of such benefit plans.*

**IMPACT & INCLUSION**

Our workplace is for ALL. We foster a culture where every background and perspective is valued so we can create meaningful memories that resonate with everyone. We aim to cultivate belonging by meeting people where they are, removing obstacles, and building on their strengths to unlock their fullest contributions. We are committed to recognizing, nurturing, and unleashing the potential in every individual on our team. Together, we're creating something powerful with purpose and impact.

Our guiding principles can be found here.

To view our compliance policies, please go to the main menu on our site GMR Marketing: Experience Marketing Agency.

title: Regional Patient Care Manager
description:
**Company Description**

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

**Why join us?**

Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now *and* build for long-term success.

**Job Description**

**How will you make an impact?**  
**Job Purpose**

As Patient Care Regional Manager, you will be the people manager and operational lead for Patient Care teams in your assigned European markets. You will own team performance, quality reviews, and day-to-day operations — while working closely with Country Managers and the Global Patient Care Head to align on priorities and ensure service consistency across markets.

You will be the missing link between global standards and local execution: someone who can read data, give direct feedback, run a tight operational cadence, and genuinely develop the people on your team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**People Management**

* Own performance reviews, 1:1s, and development conversations for direct reports across your markets
* Manage absence, availability, and team sizing for your region
* Lead hiring decisions and internal mobility within the Patient Care team
* Build a culture of direct feedback and consistent follow-through

**Operational Performance**

* Track and own regional KPIs: response SLA, first-contact resolution, CSAT, and quality scores
* Run quality review and moderation programs — calibration sessions, rubric definition, feedback loops
* Identify performance trends using dashboards and reports; translate them into concrete actions
* Own escalation protocols for complex patient cases

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Country Managers to align on priorities, workload, and service commitments
* Work with the Product/PATS team on tooling rollouts, workflow automation, and process improvements
* Contribute to the monthly Patient Voice reporting — classified ticket analysis, actionable issue surfacing
* Act as regional interface for global policy rollouts and operational changes

**Qualifications**

**What will help you thrive?**

**Must-haves**

* 5+ years in customer support, patient experience, or service operations — with at least 2 years managing people
* Experience managing teams across multiple countries in Europe (not just one market)
* Strong people instincts: direct, empathetic, consistent — someone teams trust and grow under
* Data-driven: comfortable with dashboards, pulling operational reports, and making decisions from numbers
* Experience running quality review or moderation programs (calibration, rubric design, scoring)
* Fluency in English mandatory
* Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, Notion, or similar)

**Nice to have**

* Background in healthtech, marketplace, or two-sided platforms
* Experience working with AI-assisted support tools or automation workflows
* Familiarity with Intercom, Zendesk, or equivalent support tooling
* SQL knowledge or comfort querying data independently
* Experience onboarding a new org structure or consolidating teams
* Strong plus — Spanish, Italian, Polish, or German language speaker.

title: Head of Content Performance
description:
**We've set the standard in kids entertainment.** 
**Come help us raise it.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

We're Lingokids, the #1 entertainment platform for young kids. Most kids content is designed to capture attention. We create experiences little ones genuinely love.

Everything we make is created in-house to be seriously fun, with the good stuff built in from the very beginning. We're KidSAFE certified, completely ad-free, and committed to giving families entertainment they can trust, with no compromise. Ever.

20 million kids come back to us every single month, and we've earned more than 50 awards along the way. Now we're going after something bigger: becoming the go-to entertainment destination for kids everywhere, and changing what content looks like for the generation growing up on it.

**You in? Keep on reading.**

**What you’ll do**
------------------

Our Studios create the games and content kids love. This role decides what that content has to achieve, and makes sure it does.

You're the data-driven counterpart to our creative leadership. They own how we make it. You own what we make, what we double down on, what we kill, and what success looks like.

Nobody will ask you to tell us what the data says. You'll be asked to go get the answer, yourself or through our analysts, and turn it into a decision you're accountable for.

* **Run the content portfolio.** Decide which games and content we greenlight, extend, double down on or retire, based on how much they contribute to paid subscriber retention.
* **Set success criteria for new content.** Define the targets a new game has to hit before launch and at every review after: early engagement, repeat play, retention of engaged users. "Shipped" is not a success metric.
* **Own content's contribution to paid retention.** It's your team's primary KPI. You define the leading indicators and defend them.
* **Lead release and live-ops.** Own the weekly release cadence and the content calendar: when we ship, how we package, slice and sequence content, and who sees what, when. Our Content LiveOps Manager reports to you.
* **Keep experiments running.** Build a steady pipeline of tests on launch, packaging and surfacing, with clear rules on what's worth shipping.
* **Shape how the app presents content.** Work with Product and Design on in-app surfaces, discovery and features so the content we make gets found and played. With our Director of Personalization, you define what recommendations need to achieve for content. They own the engine.
* **Tell the content performance story.** Give leadership a clear view of what content is delivering and what we do next.

### **Where the role sits**

* Reports to the VP of Studios. Peer to creative and production leadership in Studios.
* Main internal customer of the Product/Content & Engagement analytics team in Business Performance. Business Performance owns company-level metric definitions and the value-of-content measurement. You build on them, you don't duplicate them.
* Works with Growth on shared in-app surfaces, owning the Studios side.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* You've owned game or content performance as the accountable PM, GM or live-ops lead in a games business. A KPI you delivered, not one you reported.
* You've made greenlight, scale and kill calls based on data, and can walk us through the ones you got wrong.
* Fluent in retention curves, cohorts, engagement and session metrics, renewal. You know what moves them, and you tell signal from noise.
* Hands-on enough to get your own answers (SQL, Amplitude or equivalent), and you know how to brief analysts to get the rest.
* You've run a release cadence, content calendar or live-events pipeline.
* Commercial, not creative. You respect creative work and push it with targets, not taste.
* You've led a small team and built a function from a partial starting point.

**English is a must:** We’re a multicultural team providing a service in **English**, so while certifications aren’t necessary, fluency is essential. As a fully remote company, clear and effective **spoken and written communication**, especially in asynchronous and long-form formats, is key to collaborating successfully.

##### **Life at Lingokids**

**Career Growth:** Your growth drives our success! We invest in your development up to **€2,000 per year** for books and training; so you can keep learning and growing with us.

**Remote-Friendly:** Work from where you’re most productive, home or our offices in Madrid, anywhere within a **2-hour difference from Spain (GMT+1)**. The choice is yours!

**Stock Options:** Your contribution matters! You'll receive **stock options**, giving you the opportunity to own part of the company and share in its success.

**Home Office Setup:** Create your ideal workspace with a **€400 allowance** for setup and **€35/month** for remote work expenses, because comfort fuels creativity!

**Meal Allowances:** Get **€60/month** on your Cobee card to enjoy meals at restaurants or food delivery, good food makes everything better!

**Flexible Compensation:** Manage your **meal, transport and childcare expenses** easily with **Cobee**, integrating them directly into your payroll.

**Health Insurance**: Access **private health coverage** at exclusive rates through Adeslas, seamlessly deducted from your payroll, quality care made simple.

**Language Lessons:** Learning never stops! Enjoy **free language classes** in Spanish and English, to sharpen your skills and stay connected in a global team.

**Visa Sponsorship:** If you need a **visa to work in the EU**, we’ll handle the process and cover the costs to make your transition seamless.

**Company events**: Yes! We’re a fully remote team spread across different countries, but we love getting together from time to time in different corners of Spain, for team gatherings and recharging at our amazing off-sites!

### **Passion matters more than perfection**

Didn’t check every box for this role? No worries! We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who believe in our mission. If that sounds like you, we’d still love to hear from you!

### **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**

At Lingokids, diversity isn’t just a checkbox—it’s at the heart of everything we do. Just like we teach kids to embrace differences, we celebrate them in our team, knowing that the best ideas come from unique perspectives. We’re all about creating a space where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to be their authentic selves. No matter your background, identity, or story, if you’re passionate about making a difference in education, we want you here.

* Build and maintain evaluation pipelines specifically designed to measure the reliability and safety of model-tool interactions.
* Collaborate with the data team to curate high-quality instruction datasets for task-oriented dialogue and function execution.

  + Solid experience in Fine-tuning and Post-training of Large Language Models.

  + Proficiency in Python and Deep Learning libraries like PyTorch.
  + Hands-on experience with modern post-training frameworks including TRL, FastChat, or NeMo-RL.
  + Excellent level of written and spoken English.
* Additional Knowledge and Professional Experience
  + Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and API integration for LLMs.
  + Knowledge of advanced preference alignment methods like DPO, GSPO, or CISPO.
  + Experience in developing benchmarking tools for function calling and reasoning.
  + Fluency in Spanish is highly valued.
  + Knowledge of Spain’s co-official languages is a significant advantage.
* Competences
  + Strong technical execution skills with a focus on reproducibility and clean code.
  + Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented research environment.
  + Proactive problem-solving mindset when dealing with complex system integrations.
  + Detail-oriented approach to evaluating model reliability and edge cases.

* We offer a full-time contract (35h/week), a good working environment, a highly stimulating environment with state-of-the-art infrastructure, flexible working hours, extensive training plan, restaurant tickets, private health insurance, support to the relocation procedures
* Duration: Open-ended contract due to technical and scientific activities linked to the project and budget duration
* Holidays: 22 days of holidays + 6 personal days + 24th and 31st of December per our collective agreement
* Salary: we offer a competitive salary commensurate with the qualifications and experience of the candidate and according to the cost of living in Barcelona

* A full CV in English including contact details
* A cover/motivation letter with a statement of interest in English, clearly specifying for which specific area and topics the applicant wishes to be considered. Additionally, two references for further contacts must be included. Applications without this document will not be considered.
  

  
  

**Development of the recruitment process**

  
  
  
The selection will be carried out through a competitive examination system ("Concurso-Oposición"). The recruitment process consists of two phases:  
  
  

* **Curriculum Analysis:** Evaluation of previous experience and/or scientific history, degree, training, and other professional information relevant to the position. - ***40 points***
* **Interview phase:** The highest-rated candidates at the curriculum level will be invited to the interview phase, conducted by the corresponding department and Human Resources. In this phase, technical competencies, knowledge, skills, and professional experience related to the position, as well as the required personal competencies, will be evaluated. - ***60 points.*** *A minimum of 30 points out of 60 must be obtained to be eligible for the position.*
  

  
  
  

The recruitment panel will be composed of at least three people, ensuring at least 25% representation of women.

  
  
  

In accordance with OTM-R principles, a gender-balanced recruitment panel is formed for each vacancy at the beginning of the process. After reviewing the content of the applications, the panel will begin the interviews, with at least one technical and one administrative interview. At a minimum, a personality questionnaire as well as a technical exercise will be conducted during the process.

BSC-CNS is committed to the principles of the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers of the European Commission and the Open, Transparent and Merit-based Recruitment principles (OTM-R). **Context And Mission**

  

The Single- and Multi-Agent Research (SMART) group focuses on researching, evaluating and implementing formally-grounded and verifiable methods and frameworks for understanding and designing intelligent agents, mainly but not limited to logical-symbolic, reinforcement learning and LLM-augmented (agentic) agents.
  
Our research group has been consistently developing contributions in the field of multi-agent systems from several perspectives, including efficient methods for combining symbolic and sub-symbolic forms of reasoning; scalable architectures for parallel distributed execution of large volumes of agents; mechanisms and languages for encoding, interpreting and analysing the effects of social values and norms; and explainability methods in cooperative and competitive settings.
  
We are looking for a research engineer to support and lead a number of ongoing research projects in Artificial Intelligence. These projects involve knowledge areas such as agents, explainability, autonomous decision-making, multi-agent coordination and communication, and AI systems in general, applied to a wide range of use cases.
  
The selected candidate will be responsible for the day-to-day advancements and follow-up of project activities, including technical coordination, management, research and engineering support when needed. The role involves working closely with other engineers and research and support teams, technical staff, and external collaborators, ensuring that milestones, deliverables, and reporting obligations are met in accordance with funding requirements.

  

**Key Duties**

  

* Participate in engineering activities, including development and experimentation of artificial intelligence methods.
* Coordinate research project technical activities, including planning, execution, and tracking.
* Monitor project timelines and technical deliverables.
* Facilitate communication between researchers, developers, and external partners.
* Contribute to the preparation of technical reports, project documentation, and dissemination materials (in collaboration with dissemination professionals).
* Contribute to the preparation of new project proposals in collaboration with the PMO.
* Help ensure alignment with data protection, ELSEC, and open science requirements.
  

  

**Requirements**

  

* Education
  + Degree in a STEM field, ideally related to Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science or Software Engineering
* Essential Knowledge and Professional Experience
  + Experience in participating in research or innovation projects (2 years of experience)
  + Familiarity with AI or intelligent systems, either through work or academic background (3 years of experience)
* Additional Knowledge and Professional Experience
  + Experience working with publicly funded R&D projects (e.g. Horizon Europe, national programs)
  + Experience writing research proposals
  + Experience in writing scientific papers
  + Experience in multi-agent systems
  + Experience in reinforcement learning
  + Experience in designing or implementing intelligent agents
  + Mathematical and formal logics background is desirable
* Competences
  + Ability to work in multidisciplinary environments
  + Strong communication and organizational skills

**Conditions**

  

* The position will be located at BSC within the Directors Department
* We offer a full-time contract (35h/week), a good working environment, a highly stimulating environment with state-of-the-art infrastructure, flexible working hours, extensive training plan, restaurant tickets, private health insurance, support to the relocation procedures
* Duration: Open-ended contract due to technical and scientific activities linked to the project and budget duration
* Holidays: 22 days of holidays + 6 personal days + 24th and 31st of December per our collective agreement
* Salary: we offer a competitive salary commensurate with the qualifications and experience of the candidate and according to the cost of living in Barcelona
* Starting date: 01/11/2026

**Applications procedure and process**

  

All applications must be submitted via the BSC website and contain:  
  
  

* A full CV in English including contact details
* A cover/motivation letter with a statement of interest in English, clearly specifying for which specific area and topics the applicant wishes to be considered. Additionally, two references for further contacts must be included. Applications without this document will not be considered.
  

  
  

**Development of the recruitment process**

  
  
  
The selection will be carried out through a competitive examination system ("Concurso-Oposición"). The recruitment process consists of two phases:  
  
  

* **Curriculum Analysis:** Evaluation of previous experience and/or scientific history, degree, training, and other professional information relevant to the position. - ***40 points***
* **Interview phase:** The highest-rated candidates at the curriculum level will be invited to the interview phase, conducted by the corresponding department and Human Resources. In this phase, technical competencies, knowledge, skills, and professional experience related to the position, as well as the required personal competencies, will be evaluated. - ***60 points.*** *A minimum of 30 points out of 60 must be obtained to be eligible for the position.*
  

  
  
  

The recruitment panel will be composed of at least three people, ensuring at least 25% representation of women.

  
  
  

In accordance with OTM-R principles, a gender-balanced recruitment panel is formed for each vacancy at the beginning of the process. After reviewing the content of the applications, the panel will begin the interviews, with at least one technical and one administrative interview. At a minimum, a personality questionnaire as well as a technical exercise will be conducted during the process.

  
  
  

The panel will make a final decision, and all individuals who participated in the interview phase will receive feedback with details on the acceptance or rejection of their profile.

  
  
  
  

At BSC, we seek continuous improvement in our recruitment processes. For any suggestions or comments/complaints about our recruitment processes, please contact recruitment [at] bsc [dot] es.
  
For more information, please follow this link.

**Deadline**

  

The vacancy will remain open until a suitable candidate has been hired. Applications will be regularly reviewed and potential candidates will be contacted.

**OTM-R principles for selection processes**

  

BSC-CNS is committed to the principles of the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers of the European Commission and the Open, Transparent and Merit-based Recruitment principles (OTM-R). This is applied for any potential candidate in all our processes, for example by creating gender-balanced recruitment panels and recognizing career breaks etc.
  
BSC-CNS is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or any other basis protected by applicable state or local law.

title: Lead VFX Artist
description:
**Company Description**

**About Gameloft**

Here at Gameloft, we create moments of happiness for our players all over the world through exciting gaming experiences. This is our mission, and it has been the same for over 25 years. We are the proud creators of Asphalt, Dungeon Hunter, Modern Combat, and over 200 other great games.

There is a game for everyone, and we are now expanding to cross-platform games on PC and consoles, with titles such as Disney Speedstorm and Disney Dreamlight Valley, to provide our players with even more amazing adventures.

With more than 3,000 passionate Gamelofters across the globe, we take great pride in our differences and draw on them to create games just as diverse as we are.

If you’re looking for a new challenge and want to work with a bold and talented group of people, don’t hesitate to join the game!

 **Job Description**

**WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON**

**Main challenge**

We are looking for a Lead VFX Artist to lead the VFX discipline across our games, combining strong artistic expertise with team coordination, visual direction, and pipeline development. You will work closely with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio to ensure a consistent visual and technical quality across all VFX, while supporting project and studio goals.

You will oversee the VFX process from initial concepts and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery. Working with our proprietary engine and in-house tools, you will also contribute to the evolution of our VFX workflows, standards, and technology.

**What it means on a daily basis**

* **VFX Team Leadership:** Oversee and coordinate the VFX team, establish priorities, and ensure deadlines and quality targets are met. Identify and remove systemic blockers early and proactively adjust resources and scope.
* **Visual Direction & Quality:** Work with the Art Director to ensure visual and technical unity across all VFX. Review completed work against artistic, technical, and gameplay requirements and advance VFX quality through regular reviews.
* **Cross-Team Collaboration:** Collaborate with Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other teams. Provide constructive feedback to internal and external partners.
* **VFX Pipeline:** Oversee the entire VFX pipeline, from initial concept and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery.
* **Standards & Workflows:** Establish and maintain VFX standards, workflows, tools, and best practices. Ensure effects meet performance and platform requirements.
* **Team Development:** Participate in recruitment, mentor VFX artists, and foster team growth and development.

**What success will look like**

After 3 months, you will have built a strong understanding of the studio's projects, VFX workflows, team structure, and production requirements. You will have established effective working relationships with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio.

After 6 months, you will be independently driving VFX priorities, supporting the team in delivering against project goals, and contributing to the evolution of VFX standards, workflows, and quality across the studio.

**Who you would be working with**

You will report to the Studio Art Director and work closely with VFX artists, Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other art and development teams. You will also collaborate with internal and external partners throughout the production process.

**Your recruitment journey**

* HR Screen Call
* Test
* Second Interview
* Final Interview

**Where this role can take you**

This role can offer opportunities to deepen your expertise in VFX leadership, expand your responsibilities across the wider art discipline, and contribute to the development of VFX standards, workflows, and technology. You will also have access to development opportunities, mentorship, coaching, or internal mobility depending on business and individual opportunities.

 **Qualifications**

**WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED**

* Demonstrated advanced expertise in real-time VFX for games, supported by a strong portfolio.
* Strong knowledge of visual effects techniques for creating real-time VFX in a 3D game engine.
* Strong knowledge of industry-standard game engines such as Unity, Unreal Engine, or CryEngine.
* Solid understanding of game development and how VFX contribute to gameplay, visual feedback, and the overall player experience.
* Experience creating particle systems and VFX in 3D packages such as Maya, Houdini, or 3ds Max.
* Experience with VFX techniques and plugins for 3D software packages such as RayFire, Krakatoa, FumeFX, AfterBurn, or Maya Fluids.
* Ability to establish priorities, manage workflows, and coordinate a VFX team while maintaining quality and delivery standards.
* Ability to take initiative, provide creative input, and positively accept and apply feedback.
* Willingness to work with in-house tools and contribute to the development and improvement of proprietary game technology.
* Expertise in GLSL or HLSL would be beneficial.
* Previous experience in mobile game development would be a plus.
* Some experience with animation would also be a plus.
* Fluent professional English, written and spoken, for collaboration in an international environment.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* You are a creative and experienced VFX professional who can combine artistic vision with an understanding of production and technical requirements.
* You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with different disciplines and stakeholders.
* You are comfortable giving and receiving constructive feedback and using it to improve both your own work and the team's output.
* You can organise priorities, identify blockers, and proactively find solutions in a production environment.
* You are interested in developing people, processes, and workflows alongside the quality of the VFX itself.

  
**Additional Information**

**Why Join the World of Gameloft?**

* Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
* Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
* Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures!
* Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
* Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

**Benefits:**

* Permanent contract and full-time position with excellent social benefits.
* 25 vacation days per year.
* Private medical health insurance.
* Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
* Flexible work-from-home hybrid model.
* Free language courses.
* Your birthday off!
* 1 month of remote work.
* Merit-based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
* Career development opportunities.
* Excellent working conditions, with our office located in the centre of Barcelona.
* ...and Thursday after-work beers!

**We can’t wait to find our next great talent!**

Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. title: Head of Business Operations
description:
**Take over founder-led operations and build the systems that help us grow.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

You might be a consultant who moved into a startup, a founder’s associate already running important parts of a business, or an operator who has started building software and automations yourself.

You enjoy understanding how a business works, finding what slows it down, and making it work better. You can turn an unclear problem into a practical plan, bring people with you, and build the first solution.

We are looking for someone ready to take that ability further: own our operations function, lead a small team, and join the company’s leadership team.

**About us**
------------

Platform Engineering Masters is the company behind platformengineering.org and PlatformCon. We bring together engineers, technology leaders and vendors through our community, conferences, education and Weave Intelligence.

As the business grows, the systems behind it need to grow too: how we deliver for customers, run events, produce content, understand performance and share information across teams.

Our co-founder, Christoph currently leads operations. You will work closely with him during the handover, then take responsibility for running and developing the function independently. You will report to Luca, our Managing Director.

**The challenge**
-----------------

We have a working business, an existing operations team and plenty already being built. We also have manual handovers, disconnected information and processes that depend too much on particular people.

Your job is to decide what needs attention, understand the business problem behind each request, and lead the work through to a solution people actually use.

Some of the questions you will tackle:

* How do we turn a customer commitment into a reliable delivery process across sales, content and events?
* How do we give teams trustworthy information about what is working and where to focus?
* How do we make recurring work, such as publishing a webinar or delivering a sponsored asset, easy to run consistently?
* Which problems need custom software, which need better use of existing tools, and which simply need a clearer process?
* How do we keep improving our systems without making the business dependent on their original builders?

**What you will own**
---------------------

**The operations roadmap.** Work directly with Sales, Growth, Content and Events to understand their needs. Prioritize by business impact, challenge requests where necessary, and make trade-offs explicit, including when requests come from founders.

**A small, growing team.** You will manage our existing revenue operations and systems engineering specialists from the start, and help recruit and develop additional content/design and growth operations capacity.

**Hands-on delivery.** Prototype, write code, connect systems and build automations yourself when that is the fastest way to make progress. Give your team clear direction and space to own delivery.

**Systems that last.** Make sure critical workflows have clear ownership, useful documentation and sensible standards for reliability, access and maintenance.

**Adoption and results.** Work with business teams until the solution is part of their everyday work. Judge success by better delivery, useful information and time saved.

Your remit is the operational systems supporting the business. Functional leaders own their commercial, editorial and event outcomes; you work with them to make those outcomes easier to achieve.

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

* **Structured problem-solving and strong communication.** You can understand an internal customer’s needs, question assumptions and explain a recommendation clearly. Consulting or similar client-facing experience would be useful.
* **Evidence that you build.** You have used code, APIs, automation or AI tools to solve real problems. You can walk us through what you built, why you chose that approach and what happened when people used it.
* **Commercial judgment.** You connect operational improvements to revenue, delivery quality, cost or capacity.
* **Ownership in an ambiguous environment.** You can make progress without a complete brief and follow through when implementation gets difficult.
* **Readiness to lead.** You can set priorities, give useful feedback and hold a small team accountable while staying close to the work.
* **Curiosity about technology and the business.** You learn unfamiliar tools and domains quickly and care about the quality of the result.

Experience managing processes in a startup would be valuable. You do not need to have held a Head of Operations title or worked in every area this role touches. We care more about your judgment, learning speed and track record than a particular CRM certification or tool stack.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

In your first months, you will establish clear priorities with the team, take ownership of the most important systems and deliver improvements that business teams can see and use.

Over time, routine work will run with fewer manual interventions, teams will have better information, and the founders will be able to step out of day-to-day operations with confidence.

**Why join**
------------

You will inherit a real team, work directly with leadership and have the mandate to shape an important part of a growing business. This is an opportunity to move from solving individual problems to owning the function that solves them.

**Interested?**
---------------

Send us your CV or profile and a short example of something you improved or built. Tell us what the problem was, what you personally did and what changed. If you have any questions, please contact james@platformengineering.org
