**NOTE: This is a FULLY remote role, but the candidate must be within LOCATION to collaborate with their team, peers, and internal customers. You do not have to be in the specific country or city shown in this listing, but** **please only apply if you are physically based within LOCATION.**

Trusted by 20,000+ property managers worldwide, Hostaway is an industry leading, AI-powered vacation rental management platform designed for professional short-term rental operators. Hostaway brings everything together for greater efficiency and faster growth.

Profitable, high-growth, and the first short-term rental PMS unicorn . Join us at our most exciting stage yet! Learn more about our recent valuation and story here.

### **About the role**

Hostaway is looking for its first Product Analytics leader, someone to own how we choose what to build, and to prove what it delivered. This role is about setting the standards and building the tools that help teams move faster with confidence. You'll define what good looks like, set the standards for how we measure, and bring the whole product organization along with you.

You'll work alongside our product leaders, who decide which bets we make, helping make sure the evidence behind them is solid. In a company leaning hard into AI, you'll also work out what measurement even means when the AI, not the human, is doing the work. It's a rare chance to be first: to shape the processes, metrics and KPIs, in a fast-growing, profitable, AI-first company with low bureaucracy and little hierarchy. Your work will make the impact of everyone around you visible.

Reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer, this is a hands-on role where you will write SQL, build analyses, and mentor others rather than purely manage. While Data Engineering oversees the data pipelines, warehouse, and central architecture, you will own the product measurement layer on top, maintaining a dotted-line partnership with the CTO.

**Your Mission**

* Set the product measurement standard: what counts as an active, adopting customer, and how every analysis gets segmented.
* Bring measurement into planning early, so every product requirements document includes sizing, an expected metric impact and a measurement plan.
* Design measurement where clean A/B tests aren't available, and redefine it for an AI-native product where activity metrics no longer tell the full story.
* Bring numbers to investment decisions, and grow metrics fluency so product managers can bring their own numbers to reviews.
* Set the technical standards and build the function: tracking plans, instrumentation specs, data quality, starting with an experienced product analyst.
* Stay close to the work. You'll remain hands-on day to day, writing queries and building analyses yourself rather than only directing others.

* **8+ years in product analytics, ideally in B2B SaaS at a scaling stage.** We're open to strong candidates from other product backgrounds too.
* **Strong data foundations.** You know how to design clean, reliable data models together with Data Engineering, and how to set up event tracking that stays consistent across features and domains. Experience with SQLMesh is a plus. You use AI tools heavily in your own work and understand where they help and where they mislead.
* **Influence beyond your title.** You've disagreed with a senior leader about a number, backed it up with evidence, and your definition was still in use six months later. You've helped a company move from gut feel to data-led decisions, and you work patiently with product managers to find what fits a company of our size.
* **You build the function, not just run it.** You've set up analytics operating models rather than inherited them. You can build business models that hold up to a finance leader's scrutiny, and you can show what actually worked: designing fair comparisons in a complex B2B product and being honest about what a number does and does not prove.

**Nice to have**

* Measuring AI features, automated workflows or API usage; product-led growth; churn modeling; platform businesses with more than one user type (ours are property managers and their guests); travel, hospitality or property technology.

**This role probably isn't for you if...**

* You see analytics as a service desk, waiting for tickets to come in.
* You're a dashboard specialist. Dashboards are an output; the real work is changing how decisions get made.
* You've only worked in large, mature data organizations, where the frameworks and teams were already established.
* You need a formal title to have influence.

### **What we offer**

* **Competitive Compensation:** We offer competitive pay based on market rates in the country of the applicant.
* **100% Remote:** Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere within your country of residence—be it a co-working space, your home office, or even your dining room table. The choice is yours. Just don’t ask to work in our office (we don’t have one).
* **Equity:** Every role in our company comes with valuable stock options in a fast-growing and profitable company. This ensures we all share in the company’s success.
* **Values-Driven Leadership:** Our Core Values are not just words we’ve written to make us feel good. We leverage them daily when making strategic and tactical decisions.
* **Professional Growth:** Our rapid growth offers unparalleled learning and development opportunities, along with a multitude of career advancement opportunities.
* **Annual Paid Leave:** The specific amounts vary by country and are aligned with country and/or contract-specific norms.
* **Geographic Specific Benefits:** As an international employer, we offer different country-specific benefits such as Health Insurance and Pensions in countries where these perks are customary. The specifics depend on the country of the applicant.
* **Dynamic Team Culture:** As a global company with team members in over 40 countries, our diverse and international culture fuels our innovation and creativity, providing a key pillar to our success (and making it a lot of fun to work here).

Thank you for your interest. If you apply for this role, you will receive an email from our Talent Acquisition team after your application has been reviewed alongside the qualifications for this role and the qualifications of others who have applied.

title: Head of Customer Support
description:
Labhouse is a fast-growing startup that builds, launches, and scales its own AI & Productivity Apps, operating under a subscription-based business model.

Based in Barcelona, Labhouse was founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos (Co-Founders of SocialPoint).

We operate at the intersection of mobile technology, AI, and product-driven growth, with a strong focus on experimentation and performance.

Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below.

**About the Role:**
===================

We are looking for a **Head of Customer Support** to lead and scale our customer support function across our mobile apps. This role goes far beyond answering tickets: you will own the full support operation while playing a **strategic role as the voice of the user** within the company.

You will lead an initial team of **3 customer support**, ensuring high-quality, fast, and empathetic support at scale. At the same time, you will act as a key bridge between **Customer Support, Product, and Engineering**, turning user feedback, recurring complaints, and reported bugs into actionable insights that drive product improvements.

This is a **hands-on leadership role**. You will be deeply involved in day-to-day operations, setting standards, improving processes, automating workflows, and continuously optimizing how we support tens of thousands of users.

**About You:**
==============

**Experience & background:**

* Proven experience in Customer Support within a tech product, preferably mobile apps or SaaS.
* Strong track record resolving complex, high-sensitivity tickets, such as data privacy and GDPR requests (data access, deletion, consent), invoicing and billing issues, refunds and chargebacks, and account security cases.
* Solid understanding of GDPR and data protection requirements applied to customer support.
* Experience handling a good volume of tickets while keeping quality and accuracy high.
* Previous experience leading a customer support team of at least 3–4 people.
* Strong hands-on profile, comfortable being involved in daily operations, not just managing from a distance.

**AI & automation:**

* Proven hands-on experience designing and implementing AI-based automations in customer support, such as LLM-powered workflows, AI agents or chatbots, automated ticket triage and tagging, and AI-assisted responses.
* Experience with support platforms and their AI and automation capabilities (e.g., Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk) and with automation tools (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n).
* Ability to measure the impact of automations on resolution time, deflection rate, and customer satisfaction.

**Operational excellence:**

* Ability to design, document, and continuously improve support processes and workflows, including clear escalation paths for legal, billing, and security cases.
* Experience defining SLAs, KPIs, and quality standards for customer support teams.
* Experience scaling or preparing a support team for growth.

**Product & business mindset:**

* Ability to identify **recurring issues, bugs, and user complaints**, and translate them into clear insights for Product and Engineering teams.
* Experience collaborating closely with **Product Managers and Engineers** to improve the user experience.
* Strong sense of prioritization and impact, understanding what really moves the needle for users and the business.

**Leadership & communication:**

* Experience managing **remote and distributed teams**, especially across different time zones.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to align support, product, and engineering stakeholders.
* High ownership, autonomy, and accountability.

**Comunication**

* Full professional proficiency in **English** (written and spoken).
* Spanish is a strong plus.

**Nice to Have:**
=================

* Experience supporting **subscription-based products** or freemium models.
* Experience working with **AI-powered tools** or automations in customer support.
* Background in QA, product operations, or customer experience roles.
* Experience setting up or scaling support operations from an early stage.
* Experience working in startups or fast-paced scale-up environments.

**What we Offer:**
==================

* Remote work from anywhere in Spain. If you are based in Barcelona, we would love for you to join us at the office (Barcelona Tech City) at least two days a week.
* High-end equipment for your role.
* Permanent contract with competitive compensation.
* High ownership and real impact on product and user experience.
* The opportunity to build, scale, and shape the customer support function from the ground up.

**You should Know:**
====================

Labhouse is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. However you identify or whatever your journey to this point, we welcome all candidates to apply for the position that inspires them.

Come join us and help us build a company that everyone is proud to be part of.

title: Head of Platform Engineering, Barcelona
description:
Head of Platform Engineering
  
About Seqera
  
  
Seqera is on a mission to empower scientists and organizations to solve humanity s biggest challenges through data-driven science. As the company behind Nextflow and the Seqera Platform, we enable global enterprises, biotech innovators, academic institutions, and public sector organizations to scale complex data workflows with confidence.
  
  
We re a global, remote-friendly team with headquarters in Barcelona and colleagues across the US, UK, and beyond. As we continue to grow, we re strengthening our internal foundations - and that s where you come in.
  
  
About the role
  
  
We are seeking a leader for our Platform Infrastructure team. This role owns infrastructure at Seqera in both directions: the internal platform our engineers build on, and the infrastructure we ship to customers. A large share of our customers experience Seqera through the infrastructure your team produces, which means much of this work is a product surface held to a products quality bar.
  
  
You will lead a team of DevOps and security engineers, and you will be a key member in our architecture review process, where infrastructure, security, and operability are weighed at design time alongside every other significant technical decision. This is a leadership role for someone who wants to define how a growing engineering organization builds, ships, and operates.
  
  
You will report to the CTO.
  
  
What Youll Do
  
  
Own the reliability, security, and cost-effectiveness of our cloud infrastructure, and the ongoing health of the platform - what gets maintained, upgraded, and retired, not only what gets built.
  
  
Lead the technical launch of our dedicated single-tenant hosting offering: tenancy and isolation model, provisioning, upgrade and patching strategy across many customer instances, operational tooling, and the per-tenant cost model it will be priced against.
  
  
Own our Helm charts and Terraform provider as products - versioned, documented, and tested against supported deployment topologies, with the compatibility obligations that customer-deployed infrastructure carries.
  
  
Own CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and the supported path from empty repo to production, so that teams get pipelines, deployment standards, and observability defaults without assembling them each time.
  
  
**Make cloud cost an engineering discipline:** attribution by team and by tenant, anomaly alerting, an efficiency backlog with quantified savings, and cost as an input at design time rather than a surprise after the fact.
  
  
Lead our security posture in practice - security architecture applied during design review, and the security story we present to enterprise and life-sciences customers.
  
  
**Own our formal incident response:** severity definitions, an incident commander rotation, runbooks for our top failure modes, and blameless postmortems that change something.
  
  
Define what production-ready means at Seqera - tests, observability, documentation, runbooks - and hold the bar consistently across teams.
  
  
Grow and develop the Platform Infrastructure team, including active hiring at the senior engineer level and active mentorship and career planning for the whole team.
  
  
Partner with engineering, product, and customer-facing teams to bring infrastructure expertise into decisions early.
  
  
About you
  
  
You have led infrastructure, platform, or SRE teams with direct accountability for production reliability, and you are still close enough to the work to review it, set the standard, and make architectural calls yourself.
  
  
You have deep Kubernetes, Helm, and Terraform experience in enterprise settings, and strong opinions about infrastructure-as-code earned from operating it.
  
  
You have shipped infrastructure that customers deploy and run themselves. You know that charts and modules used by people you will never meet is a different discipline from internal IaC - versioning, backward compatibility, upgrade paths, and support all become your problem.
  
  
You have real security depth. You can lead a security architecture conversation rather than coordinate one.
  
  
You treat cloud cost as an engineering responsibility, and you can build cost models that stand up to commercial scrutiny.
  
  
You have built incident response rather than just carried the pager, and you have handled complex incidents including those involving customer infrastructure.
  
  
You are comfortable as a technical peer with senior engineers who will challenge you, and equally comfortable presenting to leadership and customers.
  
  
You write things down. We are moving deliberately from knowledge held by individuals to standards that are explicit, teachable, and enforceable.
  
  
You are comfortable with ambiguity, and you would rather define a platform than operate one that already exists.
  
  
**Nice to have:**  
Experience with single-tenant, dedicated, or customer-isolated deployment models - fleet provisioning, upgrade orchestration across many instances, isolation guarantees.
  
  
Developer productivity or internal developer platform experience.
  
  
Scientific, research, or high-performance computing environments large-scale batch and data-intensive workloads.
  
  
Experience with multiple cloud providers.
  
  
Release engineering experience.
  
  
Open-source community exposure - much of what we build is used in the open.
  
  
Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to enterprise life-sciences customers.
  
  
Great benefits
  
  
**Time off:** 23 days for vacations per year, 3 days given by Seqera in December, and the national/public holidays according to your location.
  
  
Equity
  
  
Private health insurance
  
  
Private life insurance
  
  
Home office allowance (valued over 1,000 USD)
  
  
Subscription to Oliva, Mental Health App
  
  
Learning and development budget per year (1,000 USD)
  
  
Location
  
  
Barcelona (Spain)
  
  
Employment Type
  
  
Full time
  
  
Department
  
  
Engineering
  
  
Nextflow, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, CI/CD

title: Head of AI Expansion
description:
***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

***Innovate with Tether***

**Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

We are seeking a highly driven Head of AI Expansion to lead the global adoption of Tether’s AI ecosystem, with a focus on QVAC and decentralized, privacy-preserving AI infrastructure.

The role will engage leading enterprises, institutions, and governments globally, helping them deploy AI solutions built around local computing, data sovereignty, privacy, and independence from centralized cloud infrastructure.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining exceptional commercial and relationship-building capabilities with deep AI knowledge. You will identify and prioritize opportunities, structure complex projects, close strategic partnerships, monitor success of partnerships and build the team required to scale Tether AI globally.

The ideal candidate can comfortably move between technical discussions with AI and engineering teams and strategic conversations with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, and government leaders and should be used to work in multiple geographies/ cultures.

International travel is required.

**Responsibilities**

Business Development & Partnerships

* Drive global adoption of QVAC and Tether AI across enterprises, institutions, and governments.
* Identify organizations where local, private, decentralized, or sovereign AI provides a strategic advantage.
* Match use cases with needs of identified organizations and build business cases for the implementation of the use case
* Nurture existing and build new relationships with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, AI leaders, and government stakeholders.
* Personally originate, structure, negotiate, and close strategic AI partnerships and deployments.
* Develop partnerships across the AI ecosystem, including compute, hardware, infrastructure, and technology providers.
* Monitor performance of partnerships, proactively identify risks and design mitigation plans

Market Strategy & Execution

* Define and execute Tether AI’s global go-to-market strategy.
* Identify priority markets, industries, and high-value AI use cases.
* Co-develop with clients their requirements and translate them into deployable solutions together with product and engineering teams.
* Build and manage a global pipeline of strategic AI opportunities.
* Monitor market, competitive, regulatory, and technological developments.

Team Leadership

* Build and lead the AI Expansion team globally.
* Recruit expansion managers, partnership leads, solution architects, and other key profiles.
* Establish KPIs, execution playbooks, and commercial processes.
* Work closely with Tether’s AI, engineering, product, and regional Expansion teams.

Strategic Representation

* Position Tether as a strategic partner for organizations seeking AI sovereignty, privacy, resilience, and infrastructure independence.
* Represent Tether AI in strategic meetings, government engagements, conferences, and industry forums.

**You Have**

* 7+ years of experience across AI, enterprise technology, infrastructure, or technology business development.
* Strong knowledge of AI/ML, LLMs, inference, local/edge computing, data infrastructure, and decentralized architectures.
* Proven experience personally originating, structuring, and closing large enterprise technology deals and partnerships.
* Strong relationships with senior decision-makers across enterprises, technology companies, and/or governments.
* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Experience building and managing high-performing teams.
* Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to operate independently in fast-moving environments.
* Degree in AI, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field.

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

title: Market Analyst
description:
**About Modo Energy**
---------------------

The energy transition is the biggest infrastructure buildout in human history. Modo Energy is the data platform at the centre of it.

We build the benchmarking, forecasting, and valuation tools that the world's most serious energy investors, developers, and operators depend on to make decisions. If a battery gets financed, built, or traded anywhere in the world, there's a good chance Modo Energy's data was in the room.

Founded in 2019, we're 90+ people across London, New York, Sydney, and Madrid; $30M Series B, AI-native, and moving fast.

This is a rare chance to join a category-defining company at the moment it's scaling globally.

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring an Iberia Market Analyst to build Modo Energy's products for Spain and Portugal. Iberia is one of Europe's fastest-moving storage markets, and our customers rely on us to understand how batteries earn revenue there.

This is a builder's role. You'll design the data workflows behind our Iberian coverage, build and ship benchmarks, and work with our European forecast team to shape the forecast product for both markets. You'll also help teach Ko, our AI analyst, to become the best source of answers on Iberia.

We're looking for a generalist. You should be as comfortable automating a data pipeline as explaining a market to a customer, and you should enjoy turning messy data into products people use.

Our coverage is battery energy storage, solar, wind and data centres, and we expect it to grow.

You'll be part of the Iberia team, reporting to the Iberia Regional Head and working closely with engineering and the European forecasting team.

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Build and automate the data workflows behind our Iberian coverage, from TSOs, NEMOs, and other sources.
* Build, maintain and ship Iberian benchmarks, working with engineering to deploy them to customers on the Modo Energy Terminal.
* Train Ko on Iberia: Improve how useful our AI model is to clients. Expose the right datasets, improve its answers, and deepen its market knowledge.
* Work with the European forecast team on the Spanish and Portuguese forecasts: fundamentals, market design, and how regulatory and market changes feed into the models.
* Maintain a grid-scale asset and capacity register for Spain and Portugal.
* Use AI to build tools and workflows that help you and the team scale.
* Contribute market insight through research and customer calls.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **The Essentials**

* You like building things, and you use AI to build tools and workflows.
* 2+ years of experience in power markets, energy analytics, data, or a technical analyst role.
* Strong programming skills. You can interrogate complex datasets and pick up new tools quickly.
* Familiarity with battery energy storage or wider energy transition themes.
* A generalist mindset: comfortable moving between data, product, and market questions.
* Clear written communication.
* Professional fluency in Spanish and English.
* You're comfortable building products for a region from the ground up.

### **Nice To Have**

* Knowledge of Iberian electricity markets: OMIE day-ahead and intraday, REE balancing services (aFRR, mFRR, RR), and the capacity mechanism.
* Experience with data pipelines or workflow orchestration (e.g. Airflow, Dagster, dbt).
* Experience building data products or modelling tools, such as revenue models or dispatch optimisation.
* A working knowledge of Portuguese.

**Please note we can only consider candidates who already have the right to work in Spain, as we can't offer visa sponsorship at this time.**

**Equal Opportunity**
---------------------

Modo Energy is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you require assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at careers@modoenergy.com.

**What You Can Expect From Us**
-------------------------------

At Modo Energy, we believe that exceptional work deserves exceptional reward. We're a high-performance team; ambitious, collaborative, and genuinely motivated by the scale of what we're trying to build.

You'll have real ownership from day one, work alongside some of the brightest people in the industry, and be part of a company that's defining a new category in the global energy market. We're hybrid: everyone works Tuesday to Thursday in office, with Monday and Friday flexible. We offer top-of-market compensation, equity for every employee, and the space to take your career wherever you want it to go.

We're looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers. If that's you, we want to talk.

title: Head of Engineering
description:
**Lead engineering that powers how thousands of finance teams spend**
=====================================================================

Spendesk is the AI-powered spend management and procurement platform trusted by thousands of finance teams across Europe. As our **Head of Engineering**, you'll lead a complete engineering group — several Engineering Managers, Senior EMs, and Staff Engineers — reporting directly to our CTO. You'll set the technical and organisational direction for your area, build the leadership team that runs it, and be accountable for the economics, reliability, and pace of everything it ships.

You will work with 2 to 4 Engineering Managers, reporting directly to you. You will collaborate with the Head of Product and the Head of Design, and other Head of Engineering responsible for other groups.

Your will be responsible for a multi-disciplinary engineering team of 20-30 people, with different seniority and skillset, spread across Europe.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

**Technical & organisational strategy**

* Define the multi-quarter technical and organisational strategy for your group, aligned with Spendesk's company strategy.
* Drive architectural decisions and simplification across your domain — clear domain boundaries, “platformisation”, debt reduction.
* Make build vs. buy vs. partner calls, and own your group's AI/tooling strategy: what to standardise, what to pilot, and how you measure impact.
* Own your area's economics — cost-to-serve, infra efficiency, hiring ROI — with a clear quarterly view, and present the commercial rationale behind your investment decisions.

**Delivery & operations**

* Be accountable for delivery and outcomes across your full portfolio of squads, balancing competing priorities without losing sight of quality.
* Establish group-level KPIs, SLOs, and operating rhythms so your teams run well without you in every room.
* Champion end-to-end observability, sensible on-call, and postmortems that actually change things — reducing incident frequency and MTTR over time.
* Sequence hiring and headcount to maximise impact, and defend that plan to stakeholders with data.

**Building your leadership team**

* Hire, develop, and retain a strong, balanced leadership team of EMs, Senior EMs, and Staff Engineers.
* Coach your managers through their hardest calls: performance conversations, hiring decisions, prioritisation trade-offs.
* Lead performance calibration for your group and make the final call on promotions and compensation.
* Build succession plans for your key leadership roles, so no single departure puts your group at risk.
* Actively invest in retaining your best people, and keep a genuine pulse on team sentiment.

**Influence beyond your team**

* Represent Engineering in company-wide forums, partnering closely with Product, Design, Data, and customer-facing teams.
* Communicate your strategy and trade-offs clearly to both engineers and executives — you're as comfortable defending a roadmap to the leadership team as you are challenging an incident response plan.
* Champion diversity and inclusion in how you hire, develop, and run your organisation.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 8+ years in software engineering with increasing scope, including 3+ years managing managers (Team Leads/EMs).
* A track record of delivering complex, multi-stakeholder programmes in product-led SaaS on time, on budget, with measurable results. Fintech, payments, or compliance experience is a strong plus.
* Hands-on experience operating distributed systems at scale in production, and enough technical depth to earn credibility with ICs and Team Leads, not just manage around them.
* Comfort with our stack (TypeScript, Node, React, AWS…). You don't need to write code daily, but you need to read it and question it.
* Real business acumen: you can talk unit economics, ROI, and trade-offs as fluently as you talk architecture.
* A genuine track record of growing managers into better managers, not just engineers into better engineers.

**Why this role, why now**
==========================

You'll join at a moment where the group you lead has room to simplify, room to invest in AI-augmented engineering, and a leadership team worth building further. You'll have a documented path behind you and ahead of you: Spendesk's Engineering Leadership Growth Journey maps the road from Engineering Manager through Head of Engineering to CTO, so you'll know exactly what's expected of you, and what growing further looks like once you're here.

You'll be based in one of our offices (Paris, London or Barcelona), with a flexible on-site rhythm agreed with your team.

As we are an international team, please submit your application and CV in English.

**About Spendesk**

Spendesk is the AI-powered spend management and procurement platform that transforms company spending. By simplifying procurement, payment cards, expense management, invoice processing, and accounting automation, Spendesk sets the new standard for spending at work. Its single, intelligent solution makes efficient spending easy for employees and gives finance leaders the full visibility and control they need across all company spend, even in multi-entity structures. Trusted by thousands of companies, Spendesk supports over 200,000 users across brands such as Payfit, Accor, Welcome to the Jungle, Swile, Big Mamma, Malt and Yousign. With offices in the United Kingdom, France, Spain and Germany, Spendesk also puts community at the heart of its mission.
  
  
For more information: www.spendesk.com/press  
  
**About our people & culture**

We believe that people do their best work when they’re given the freedom to thrive and grow. That’s why liberation is at the core of everything we do. We empower Spendeskers to take ownership of their work, to navigate ambiguity, and seize every opportunity. Spendeskers come from all over the world (35+ countries and counting!) but we have plenty in common: we're bold, ever-curious, committed to kindness, and tackle every challenge with a positive mindset.
  
  
**About our benefits**

Our culture is built on trust, empowerment, and growth — with benefits to match!

* Flexible on-site and remote policy
* Latest Apple equipment — the tools you need to excel
* Access to Moka.care — for emotional and mental health wellbeing
* Great office snacks — to fuel your day
* A positive team to work with daily!

We also offer location-specific benefits tailored to each market, including health insurance, wellness allowances, commuter support, meal vouchers, and gym memberships — ensuring you're well supported wherever you're based.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

At Spendesk, we're committed to fostering an environment where all differences are encouraged, supported and celebrated. We're building our culture for everyone, with everyone. Our goal is to attract and build a diverse, equal and inclusive team, where everyone feels welcome and we truly embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

Département

Product Engineering

Role

We're Camping, a brand storytelling and video agency in Barcelona. We help B2B tech companies go from 'boring' to heartfelt, through brand work and video.

Have we mentioned we have a 4-day workweek?

We have more video ad campaigns coming in than our project team can run, and some of them could start in the next few weeks. So we're looking for one more project manager, as a freelancer.

A campaign for us is usually 6 to 12 ads, and then the cutdowns, resizes and language versions for every platform. More and more often the videos are made fully or partly with AI. You take the campaign from the kickoff call to the last file. You're the client's main contact, you send them scripts and cuts, collect their feedback and turn it into clear next steps for the team.

You'll work with our creative director, strategists, AI creatives, producers and freelance editors and motion designers. You won't be the director or the strategist. * Plan pre-production and shoots with our producers, directors and production partners
* Book and brief freelance editors, motion designers, color and sound, and track every revision round
* Keep Asana, Notion and Frame.io up to date, so anyone on the team can see where a project stands
* Check every ad before it goes to the client: formats, aspect ratios, subtitles, specs for each platform
* Flag changes to timeline, budget or scope to our Head of Production before you promise anything to the client

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 3+ years as a project manager, producer or post-production coordinator on ads and campaigns, in an agency or a production company
* You know how post-production works: edit, motion, color, sound and final deliveries
* You've handled campaigns with many versions of the same ad, and you don't lose track of which cut is the latest
* You've been the main contact for clients, and you can say no when a request doesn't fit the plan
* Fluent English and Spanish. Our clients work in English, and a lot of our team and suppliers work in Spanish

This is a freelance role at 2,500 EUR per month (plus VAT), invoiced as a freelancer or a company. We work with you full-time on our 4-day week, Monday to Thursday, with flexible hours and at least two days a week at our office in Poblenou.

title: Director, Key Accounts
description:
Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara.

We use advanced machine learning to create engineering-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure.

By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future.

Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe.

**Director, Key Accounts**

We're seeking a driven, dynamic, and strategic commercial leader to drive growth across our key accounts in Europe. This is a hands-on, high-impact player-coach role focused predominantly on personal account execution paired with informal team leadership and commercial mentoring.

To succeed in this role, you will need a consultative mindset, excellent communication skills, and knowledge of the utilities industry. You will also need a proven track record of commercial execution across large, multi-year, multi-faceted contracts, and experience leading or mentoring a customer-facing team.

**What You'll Do**

* Personally own and grow relationships with a portfolio of our most strategic accounts, serving as the senior commercial relationship owner and executive point of contact.
* Develop and deliver expansion plans across assigned key accounts to execute against business metrics and revenue goals.
* Coach the team on account strategy, executive engagement, and commercial execution on complex, multi-year contracts.
* Identify new workflow improvements and use-case opportunities, helping to upskill the broader customer-facing team in commercial best practices.
* Collaborate with Customer Success Operations, Customer Value Architects, and Product on overall account strategy and execution.
* Develop processes to scale the Key Account Management function as Neara's European business grows.
* Co-present with utilities at key conferences and events across Europe, helping elevate Neara’s market presence.
* Report on account performance, pipeline, and expansion opportunities to senior leadership.

**Who You Are**

* Demonstrated history of personally managing and expanding enterprise-level accounts within complex technical or SaaS environments, ideally operating as a Director of Key Accounts, Director of Sales, Key Account Manager, Client Partner, or in a similar enterprise role.
* Domain exposure to the utilities sector or a similarly complex, technical, infrastructure-heavy industry is highly desirable.
* Experience leading, managing, or mentoring Account Managers or Customer Success Managers, ideally in a player-coach capacity.
* Experience in strategic sales, management consulting, or tech-enabled enterprise environments.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to navigate executive dynamics and foster a collaborative, customer-centric culture internally.
* Fluent in English (required); additional European languages are a plus.

**What We Are Offering You**

* Competitive salary + commission structure.
* Significant development opportunities with scope for lateral and upward movement in a high-growth company.
* Highly meritocratic, non-bureaucratic, and low-ego work culture.
* The opportunity to play a direct, critical role in expanding Neara’s footprint across Europe’s largest utilities to solve real-world infrastructure problems.
* Enjoy the opportunity to work across multiple business areas and build relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.

title: Director of User Experience, Core Commerce team - Spain, Remote
Commercial Head - Iberia
description:
**Role Overview**

The Commercial Head – Iberia will initially build the Iberian strategy and organisation for Bimeda to enter Spain and Portugal, and then lead the regional commercial organisation, overseeing a team of Key Account Managers and/or Territory managers / Customer service representatives across the various animal health channels. This role is responsible for shaping the regional commercial strategy, accelerating customer and margin growth and strengthening partnerships across the veterinary industry.

The ideal candidate brings proven commercial leadership experience in the Spanish and Portuguese animal health sector, is a proven team leader, and combines this with strong strategic capabilities and a deep understanding of local market dynamics, including regulation, customer behaviour, and channel evolution.

**Reporting, Location & Scope**

* Reports to: EU Commercial Director
* Location: Based in Spain, with regular travel across Iberia and periodic travel to Bimeda’s European sites.
* Portfolio scope: Bimeda’s livestock and equine range

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Build, lead and inspire a team of Key Account and/or Territory Managers to cover the Spanish and Portuguese markets
* Build capability in key account management and value-based selling
* Set clear objectives, coach performance, and create a high-performance culture built on accountability and customer focus.
* Take accountability for ensuring compliance with all relevant veterinary medicines regulations across both markets, working closely with Regulatory Affairs and the Responsible Person.

**Commercial Strategy**

* Build and own the local commercial strategy, defining long-term direction for growth across our species portfolios.
* Identify and prioritise high-value opportunities, including new product launches, category expansion, shifts in customer behaviour, and customer group consolidation.
* Ensure strategic alignment with European and global business priorities.
* Define and continuously review the route to market.
* Move quickly to take advantage of fast-moving market opportunities – such as competitor out-of-stock situations, special import opportunities, and short-term supply gaps – to capture volume and grow market share.
* Monitor the competitive landscape, competitor pricing, and wider market trends, using this insight to anticipate threats and identify new sources of growth.

  

**Customer & Market Leadership**

* Oversee relationships with key veterinary corporate groups, buying groups, wholesalers/distributors, and integrators.
* Support Key Account Managers in developing robust joint business plans that deliver growth, category performance, and compliance.
* Guide the team through complex price, volume, and contract negotiations, ensuring sustainable long-term partnerships.
* Oversee all customer contracts and trading agreements being put in place, ensuring terms are clearly documented, commercially sound, and consistently applied across the customer base.
* Apply robust segmentation across customers to ensure focus remains on highest potential customers and products
  

**Performance Management**

* Drive delivery of revenue, margin, and market share targets across Iberia
* Lead accurate demand and sales forecasting, pipeline management, and performance analysis across product segments.
* Ensure pricing, promotional execution, and investment decisions maximise profitability and ROI
* Enable robust gross-to-net (GTN) % evolution and customer-focused rebate management programmes, evolving our go-to-market model where required
* Ensure all customer rebates, discounts, and promotional offers are monitored, accurately accrued, and fully accounted for, so that the true net cost of trade investment is understood and controlled.
* Work with Finance to manage customer credit, debtor days, and working capital, ensuring agreed trading terms are adhered to and overdue accounts are actively managed.
  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Marketing, Technical teams, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure seamless execution of commercial plans.
* Partner with technical and marketing teams to strengthen value propositions and enhance customer outcomes.
* Represent the Iberian markets in regional planning forums, providing market insight and commercial recommendations.

  

**Experience & Skills Required**

Industry Experience

* Strong understanding of veterinary and agricultural channels, including corporate groups, wholesalers, and integrators
* Direct experience of the Spanish and/or Portuguese animal health market, with an established network across veterinary corporate groups, buying groups, and distributors.
* Knowledge of the livestock and equine production-animal sectors, and a working understanding of the Spanish (AEMPS) and Portuguese (DGAV) veterinary medicines regulatory frameworks.

  

Commercial & Leadership Experience

* Proven track record in senior commercial or national sales roles, dealing with large veterinary and trade customers
* Experience managing and developing high-performing commercial teams.
* Demonstrated ability to shape and execute commercial strategy at country or regional level.
* Strong financial acumen with the ability to interpret sales data, margin performance, and investment impact.
* Strong contract negotiation skills, with experience structuring customer agreements, rebates, and trading terms, and a working understanding of the veterinary medicines regulatory environment.
* Third-level qualification in a science, veterinary, agricultural, business, or commercial discipline; a relevant postgraduate or commercial qualification is an advantage.
* Fluency in Spanish is essential; working proficiency in Portuguese is a strong advantage. Professional fluency in English is required for reporting and collaboration within Bimeda’s European and global organisation.

  

**About Bimeda**

Bimeda is a leading global innovator, manufacturer and marketer of veterinary pharmaceuticals and animal health products and has over half a century’s experience in providing science-driven solutions to optimize the health, wellbeing and productivity of the world’s animals.

Bimeda’s global innovation program sees six state-of-the art R&D centers across four continents collaborate on an enviable product development pipeline which anticipates the ever-evolving needs of the animal health industry.

Bimeda’s nine manufacturing facilities across seven countries allow the company to manufacture a broad range of preventative, curative and nutritional products including sterile injectables, vaccinations, nutritional boluses, feed additives, tablets, water-soluble powders, pastes and non-sterile liquids.

Globally, the company focuses on the development, manufacture and commercialization of quality Bimeda-branded products while also being the partner of choice for contract manufacturing and R&D services for prominent companies within the animal health industry.

description:

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help create the unknown!

 **Description du poste**

The rigger will bridge needs between the modellers and animators to maximize efficiency of rigging (joints/bones) and skinning (skin and clothes meshing), and work in close collaboration with the technical director to create tools that the animators will need.

**Responsibilities**

* Based on the models provided by character modelers, carry out character rigging and skinning to meet the needs of the project’s animators, technical directors, and art directors.
* Adjust the skeleton whenever necessary.

* Configure the ragdolls (procedural animations with physics engine).
* Suggest in-game softbody configurations and resolve any issues that may arise by recommending solutions that ensure realistic animated movement.
* Help determine expectations with the art director by demonstrating tangible impacts of his vision and/or vision changes.
* Ensure good use of project’s naming convention and create selection sets in master scenes to facilitate the animators’ work.
* Ensure that rigging/skinning final results meets the project’s artistic standards.
* Carry out all other related tasks.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 2-3 years’ experience in video game modelling and/or animation or other relevant experience.
* Knowledge of controllers and/or Max Script and/or Python and/or Motion Builder.
* Knowledge of IK, and optimal pivot point emplacements.
* Extensive knowledge of Character Studio/biped.
* Basic knowledge of animation and modelling.
* Knowledge of the game pipeline.
* Extensive anatomical knowledge.
* College diploma in 3D technical animation for video games or equivalent.

* Employee mental health assistance.

title: Learning Support Assistant
description:
**About the School - The British School of Barcelona (Sitges):**  
The British School of Barcelona (BSB) is a great school in a wonderful location. We are an HMC school and were judged by a recent BSO (British Schools Overseas) inspection to be outstanding in every area, including quality of education, safeguarding, pupil welfare and academic outcomes.
  
  
BSB is a large, very popular school for children aged 3 to 18. Our curriculum is based on the English National Curriculum, and we offer a wide range of GCSEs, A levels, BTEC and the International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB), all alongside a significant enrichment programme.
  
  
Approximately 2350 students from more than 74 nationalities attend the school and over 375 staff work at BSB. We are based in three locations, two just outside the city of Barcelona – in Castelldefels, where we have a Primary, Secondary and Pre-University campus, and in the cosmopolitan town of Sitges, where we have another Primary campus. There are two more campuses in Barcelona, located in the heart of the city and featuring a Foundation campus, BSB Esperanza, which offers EY and Year 1 (opened in September 2021), as well as a brand-new main campus, BSB Luca, which offers Primary, Secondary, and Pre-University education and opened in September 2023.
  
  
In September 2026 we opened another campus, initially for EYFS and Primary-aged students, north of Barcelona, in the Maresme area.
  
  
The growth of the school has been accompanied by significant investment over recent years, including the building of a state-of-the art Pre-University Centre (Nexus), a full-sized 4G rugby and football pitch, dedicated STEAM facilities and the new BSB City and Maresme campuses.
  
  
Barcelona is a wonderful place to live, combining an amazing city with beaches and mountains nearby. The quality of life is excellent with a mild climate and year-round sunshine.
  
  
The school now has an exciting opportunity for an experienced **Learning Support Assistant** to join our fantastic team.
  
  
**About Cognita:**  
Cognita is a global leader in independent education. Founded in 2004, we are a growing community of 90 schools in 20 countries - in Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia and the Middle East - serving more than 100,000 students. Each of our schools are proudly unique, however our collective purpose is to create an environment where everyone can, "Thrive in a rapidly evolving world".
  
  
**About the Role:**  
We are looking for a part-time Learning Support Assistant to join our team at BSB Sitges Campus, working mornings. As a Learning Assistant at BSB, you will form part of the Learning Support Team. You will be required to demonstrate an informed and efficient approach to teaching and learning by adopting relevant strategies to support the work of the teachers and increase achievement of all pupils, including those with special educational needs and disabilities.
  
  
The appointed Learning Assistant will need a proven excellent track-record of:
  

* Demonstrating an understanding of how young children best learn.
* Communicating effectively and sensitively with pupils to adapt to their needs and support their learning.
* Contributing to effective assessment and planning by supporting the monitoring, recording and reporting of pupil performance and progress as appropriate to the level of the role.
* Knowing each individual child and supporting teachers to adapt teaching and learning to meet the specific needs of each pupil.
* Maintaining an interactive and inspiring learning environment.
* Ensuring well-being is at the heart of our provision.
* Having good interpersonal skills and able to work well as part of a team.
* Being committed to on-going professional development.

  
  
  
**Who We Are Looking For:**  
The ideal candidate will support the education and social development of pupils under the direction of the Headteacher, Director of Student Support, Learning Support Lead and class teachers.
  
We require:
  

* English: advanced.
* Qualification in support teaching and/or working with children with special educational needs.
* Minimum 2 years of experience providing support in teaching (desirable)

  
Join a team of enthusiastic individuals who appreciate the rigour of the English curriculum but embrace the freedoms offered by an international setting.
  
A commitment to the wider life of the school, and our enrichment programme, is an expectation of the job.
  
All positions are offered with attractive packages including competitive salaries, places for staff children in BSB, and other local benefits.
  
  
**Benefits at Cognita:**  
What we can offer you:
  

* A fantastic team of staff who are committed, supportive and collaborative.
* An opportunity to learn new skills.
* The wider support of BSB including access to high level CPD and future career opportunities.
* The support of the Cognita network including cross-school collaborative learning partnerships.

  
**How to Apply:**  
Complete this application before the closing date. The Closing Date for Applications is: **9am Friday 16th October 2026 (Spanish time).**  
  
Cognita Schools are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment. Safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks will be undertaken before any appointment is confirmed.
  
  
We are an equal opportunities employer committed to diversity and treating all employees with dignity and respect regardless of background.
  
  
Early applications are encouraged, we reserve the right to interview and appoint prior to closing date for the right applicant.

description:
**Who we are:**

At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.

Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.

We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

**About the role**  
Rover is looking for a Director of Product Management to lead the Provider Product Group inside our Global Provider Organization. In this role, you will own the product strategy and execution of Rover's multi-year provider roadmap: concentrating investment on our most successful providers while engaging our broader community of caregivers to strengthen marketplace depth and develop a high quality pipeline.  
You will lead four product teams working in service to our care providers, improving their experience and how they interact with the marketplace at every stage of their journey. This is a high-impact role that requires a unique blend of strategic vision and detailed-oriented, hands-on execution. You will set multi-year product direction and drive rigorous, experiment-led execution. The role carries direct accountability for supply-side revenue, provider retention, and new-customer booking growth.  
This role reports directly to the Senior Director of Supply based in Barcelona, and partners closely with Data Science, Engineering, Design, Trust & Safety, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Legal, and the International Business Team.  
As a people leader, you will manage a team of product managers based primarily in Barcelona and coordinate with cross-functional teams across Europe and the US.

* *This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Barcelona Office in the Poblenou neighborhood two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.*

### **What you'll own**

Execution is delivered hand-in-hand with cross-functional partners; your job is to define the vision and what good looks like, sequence the bets, hold the alignment, and make sure all investments reinforce each other through excellent execution.

* **Product Strategy and Vision.** Own the multi-year provider product vision: translating Rover's provider strategy into a sequenced product direction and owning the narrative that aligns leadership, product teams, and partners behind it.
* **Roadmap and execution.** Own the product side of the organization's OKRs and the roadmap that delivers them. Ship a steady cadence of well-crafted, experiment-validated launches, landed with quality and followed through after launch until the customer outcome is proven or the outcome is learned.
* **The voice of the provider.** You will be the advocate for what providers actually want and need to grow and run top quality businesses, grounding every roadmap decision in customer research, feedback, and marketplace data, and representing that voice credibly in every executive conversation, including when it's inconvenient.
* **AI adoption.** AI embedded in product features such as assisted tooling, intelligent messaging, personalization and education, as well as fostering AI in how the team works (AI-accelerated discovery, prototyping, execution), while building a culture of AI-native development as the default.
* **Cross-functional leadership.** Hold alignment across Core Product Teams, Design, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Legal and Trust & Safety, and across regions, so that product investments reinforce each other globally rather than fragmenting by service, brand or country.
* **A team that sets the bar.** Hire, coach and grow a team of product managers who combine judgment, customer centricity, inspiring craft and speed.

### **Minimum qualifications**

* 10+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time in marketplace, platform, or two-sided business contexts. Experience in the supply-side of the marketplace is a plus.
* 5+ years in people management or leadership roles, including managing senior product managers or leading cross-functional groups.
* Experience driving marketplace monetization — pricing, fee, or take-rate models — including designing, testing, and scaling pricing changes with measurable P&L impact.
* Track record of building retention, engagement, and loyalty strategies for a professional user segment (providers, sellers, hosts, drivers, or merchants).  
  Experience partnering with Data Science and Engineering teams to create and execute on shared roadmaps and metrics, with rigorous experimentation practice (A/B frameworks, holdouts, long-horizon measurement).
* Clear and structured written and verbal communication style, with the ability to influence and partner with senior leaders and diverse teams to drive critical decisions.
* Highly proactive, comfortable operating with minimal guidance in uncertain and ambiguous business environments.
* Analytical rigour, with enthusiasm for modeling and measuring the impact of the initiatives you drive. Comfortable working with advanced analytical and visualization tools, such as Mode and Excel.
* Strong leadership skills and experience giving actionable feedback and coaching, and welcoming the same.
* Comfortable working across Europe (Central Time) and US (Pacific Time) timezones.
* Strong command of the English language (minimum C2 level). English is the official Rover language and is used every day with every stakeholder and communication.  
  Bachelor's degree.

### **Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in online marketplaces with a meaningful supply side (gig economy, services marketplaces, accommodation, mobility, creator platforms, or similar).
* Experience with marketplace integrity problems: disintermediation and off-platform leakage, and incentive design that rewards loyal behavior.
* Experience building customer-centric tooling, business-management software, or 'operating system' products for independent entrepreneurs.
* Demonstrated success leading both 0-to-1 product bets and scaling existing product lines; comfort presenting to C-level and Board audiences.
* Master's degree.

* Permanent contract
* Long-term incentive plan, with a company performance-based cash payout
* Pension Plan
* Meal tickets through Cobee
* 25 days paid time off, plus public holidays

* Flexible work hours. We trust you to get your work done, and are not watching what times you're coming and going
* Snacks and fresh fruit in our kitchen to keep yourself going
* Regular team activities, including happy hours, game nights, and more

### **Compensation:**

title: Account Director, Client Solutions (EMEA)
description:
Account Director, Client Solutions (EMEA)
=========================================

**Location:** Remote. Continental Europe or compatible time zone preferred. (roughly UTC-1 to UTC+3)

**Clients:** Global. Primarily EMEA and North American.

**Reports to:** VP of Solutions

**Salary Range:** $80,000 - $150,000 USD annually, plus bonus/commission based on acquisition and growth of client accounts. Compensation dependent on candidate experience and location.

About McGaw

**Our Mission at McGaw.io is to help companies of all sizes realize their customer data is their most valuable business asset, and we help them realize that through customer data infrastructure, high power analytics, marketing automation, personalization, and funnel optimization.**

McGaw.io supports businesses with analytics, marketing automation, customer data platforms, data piping, websites, AB testing, and all sorts of marketing operations. As we derive insights from these technical efforts, we also inform & execute growth strategies that routinely move the needle for our clients.

Our track record is impeccable, and our leadership has supported some of the fastest-growing companies in the world. McGaw.io’s core client base sells online and has complex data and marketing practices that drive our team to dig deeper every day.

Mission
-------

Own a portfolio of client relationships. Set the strategy, keep accounts healthy and profitable, grow them, win new ones, and get the technical work delivered through the team rather than by doing it yourself.

Why this role exists
--------------------

Accounts need a senior owner accountable for whether they renew and whether they grow. Outside North America that accountability sits in the wrong time zone, so the client's executive sponsor talks to us at the end of their day and the relationship runs a meeting behind.

This is the commercial and strategic owner. It is not the technical builder.

Three problems this role solves:

* Nobody outside North America is accountable for account health, retention, and expansion.
* Executive conversations happen at inconvenient hours, so they happen less often.
* Expansion is reactive. Nobody plans the next six months before the current scope runs out, and nobody runs discovery in European hours.

Responsibilities
----------------

**Relationship ownership**

* Own the relationship at executive level. You are who the client's CMO or VP of Growth calls.
* Run the cadence: biweekly client meetings, monthly roadmap and SOW reviews, quarterly business reviews covering results, maturity, next quarter, and risks.
* Keep the client informed before they have to ask. Never surprise them on budget or timeline.

**Strategy and consulting**

* Find where revenue leaks across acquisition, conversion, and retention. Map every problem to pain, metric, impact, and fix.
* Build and defend the growth roadmap with the client, not at them.
* Do the strategic hands-on work yourself: measurement frameworks, KPI definition, funnel and cohort analysis, lifecycle program design, experiment roadmaps, readouts.
* Translate technical decisions into business consequences the client can act on.

**Delegation and project leadership**

* Scope the work, then hand it to architects and engineers with enough detail that it gets built right.
* Manage the project, not the build. Sprint cadence, board hygiene, dependencies, risks, critical path.
* Review delivered work against the client's objectives before it ships. You are not the QA engineer, but you are accountable for whether the client got what they were told they would get.
* Know enough to challenge an estimate and spot a bad technical answer. You do not write the code.

**New business**

* Run pre-sales discovery. Qualify hard, and say no when a prospect is not ready.
* Build and present proposals: scope, phasing, investment, and the business case. Presented live, never sent cold.
* Price work so it delivers profitably. A generous estimate at proposal is a delivery problem in month three.
* Work with Sales through qualification, discovery, and close, then take the account into delivery.

**Commercial**

* Own retention and expansion on your portfolio. You are measured on both.
* Every scope change gets estimated, documented, and confirmed in writing before work starts.
* Run the six-month roadmap cycle so the next engagement is signed before the current one ends.

Skills and experience
---------------------

**Required**

* Fully fluent in English. That is the company's working language.
* Multilingual with professional working proficiency in English as well as German, French, Spanish, or Italian.
* 10+ years in consulting, agency, or professional services. At least 5 owning senior client relationships with a revenue number attached.
* Understand the full marketing lifecycle: demand generation, nurturing, acquisition, retention, and growth, and where revenue leaks between the stages.
* Understand how martech drives marketing, from ads to CDPs to marketing engagement platforms, CRM, and analytics.
* Advise on the systems below: which to use, how they fit together, the tradeoffs, and how to get more from what a client already owns. You do not configure them. You do need to be right about them, and to spot a bad technical answer when you are given one.
* Advanced understanding of marketing and growth analytics, attribution, and how to leverage data to improve marketing returns.
* Track record retaining and expanding accounts, with figures a former manager would confirm.
* Pre-sales experience: discovery, scoping, writing proposals, and presenting them to executive buyers.
* Scope and price technical work profitably.
* Know how European businesses buy, contract, and operate across markets, including procurement, data protection, and consent.

**Systems.** Advisory command of these. Depth in at least three groups.

* Customer data platforms: Segment, Hightouch, RudderStack
* Analytics: Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4
* Lifecycle and marketing automation: Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, Iterable
* Warehouse and transformation: Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt
* Tag management: Google Tag Manager, server-side GTM
* CRM: Salesforce, HubSpot
* Consent management: OneTrust, Cookiebot, Didomi

**Preferred**

* Accounts across multiple countries or regulatory regimes.
* Work across both European and North American clients.
* Built or seeded a regional practice before.

What you get out of this
------------------------

* You own the full commercial arc of an account, from discovery through renewal and expansion. At a larger firm that is three people's jobs.
* The customer data layer is changing right now. Warehouse-native patterns, composable CDPs, and reverse ETL are replacing a decade of assumptions. You advise on the new pattern while most of the market still sells the old one.
* We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors. That includes telling a client when they already have what they need.
* Many industries and stacks in a year instead of one in five, on both sides of the Atlantic.

Observable indicators
---------------------

**Month 2**

* Onboarded onto your accounts, each with a current-state assessment and named client objectives.
* Time tracked in Harvest weekly, without reminders.
* Every account's decision-maker has met you and knows what you own.

**Month 4**

* Running your accounts independently: meetings, roadmap reviews, budget conversations, scope changes.
* Every account has three or more months of planned roadmap.
* Zero undocumented scope changes.
* Technical work delegated with specs good enough that it does not come back for rework.
* Running discovery calls and contributing to proposals.

**Month 6**

* 90% of client objectives hit within the project timeline.
* Labor efficiency ratio of 3.0 across your portfolio.
* Client approval for a case study or testimonial on at least one account.
* Writing and presenting proposals independently.

**Month 9**

* 80% retention of your accounts in recurring contracts over a rolling three months.
* 20% of your retainers expanded over a rolling 90 days.
* Your proposals deliver at or above target labor efficiency. Your estimates hold up.
* Representing McGaw independently in sales and partner meetings.

What this role is not
---------------------

* Not a hands-on build seat although you will get into the tools if you need to.
* Not a prospecting seat. You run discovery, write and present proposals, own retention and expansion, and earn commission on it. You do not cold prospect.
* Not a people management seat at hire. You direct a project team. Managing a team comes later, if the business grows and you have shown you can.

Values
------

* Never Settle, Be Amazing. Fix it properly, not just enough to close the ticket.
* Get Better Every Day. Ask for feedback and change what you do when you get it.
* Give Context and Set the Stage. Nobody on your account is surprised by what you already knew.
* Let the Data Create Transparency. Recommendations come with evidence. So does bad news.
* Show Hospitality to Build Trust. Clients and teammates get proactive, responsive treatment.

Plus extreme ownership. Own the outcome, surface blockers early, and never hand a problem back to the person who gave it to you.

Benefits
--------

* Flexible PTO
* Flexible hours
* Work remotely
* Monthly per diem for premium health, dental, and vision coverage if not already available
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Retirement contribution of 3% of salary annually.
* Company laptop, monitor, and remote setup equipment
* National holidays off.
* Radically transparent workplace
* Room to act on your own ideas

The job in practice
-------------------

McGaw is a customer data and revenue operations consultancy. Clients come to us with traffic, tools, and data, and no system connecting them. We find where revenue leaks across acquisition, conversion, and retention, then we fix it with our hands on the keyboards.

The CDP is the center of most of our work. We build on Segment, Hightouch, and RudderStack, chosen per client. We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors.

Our clients are in North America and Europe. Your portfolio will be a mix.

**Month 1.** Learn our clients, delivery model, and commercial standards. Meet every stakeholder on your accounts. Shadow client meetings, QBRs, and pre-sales calls.

**Months 2 and 3.** Take ownership of your accounts. Run the meetings, rebuild the roadmaps, take over the budget conversations. An experienced account owner stays close.

**Months 4 to 6.** Run your portfolio independently. Hit your labor efficiency target. Start running discovery and writing proposals.

**After 6 months.** You own the commercial arc on your accounts, from first discovery call through renewal. You help define what the next hires look like.

**What is hard.** You are accountable for delivery you did not perform, done mostly by people in another time zone. Managing that gap is most of the job. Pre-sales competes with delivery, and both are urgent. Work is billable by the hour, so time tracking is not optional. Expansion targets are real and measured.
