title: AI Project Manager
description:
At Sanoma Learning, we all share a deep-rooted passion for education and are committed to support teachers to help all students to reach their potential, so they can be at their best in class. We are proud of the impact we make together across Europe, local as well as international. As our teams and the scope of our impact grows, so do the opportunities for us to learn from each other – across country borders and areas of expertise. With over 3.000 colleagues, we work on seamlessly integrated print, digital and blended learning solutions to help teachers and schools develop the talents of every child. Our people are passionate and committed and always willing to go the extra mile for students, teachers, schools, our shareholders and each other.

We believe that Data and AI can uncover multiple opportunities for education, including both internal efficiencies and new product opportunities; currently AI is a priority theme for Sanoma Learning.

**AI Project Manager**

The AI Project Manager is part of the AI Enablement team – the small central team that makes AI work at Sanoma Learning possible: setting direction, building the foundations, and connecting the many parties involved. The team works as a flexible unit: members take ownership of the initiatives that matter most at a given moment, and capacity is redirected as priorities shift.

Within that team, this role carries a clear centre of gravity: it is the connection point between AI at Sanoma Learning and the outside world, and between the AI team and the functions that own communication and strategy. The role does not replace those functions. It makes sure they have the AI substance, the right experts and the right coordination to do their work well – and it turns what the AI teams do into something that colleagues, customers, partners and the wider education community can understand and engage with.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Head of Data and AI, the AI Project Manager works across operating companies and central functions – Communications, Strategy, M&A, Legal and the product and experimentation teams – and represents the AI agenda in those forums. This role also assumes matrix reporting into the Competence Lead of Project Management.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI communication – internal and external**

Acting as the AI team’s counterpart to the Communications function: bringing the content, the context and the experts, and coordinating the AI side of delivery.

* **Own the editorial cycle of the AI update newsletter** – collect input from AI initiatives and opcos, shape the story, manage the calendar and the review loop with Communications.

* **Run the AI webinar and event series** – programme, speakers, preparation of presenters, logistics with the relevant functions, and follow-up.

* **Curate and maintain the AI Hub** – keep it current and usable, agree the content structure with contributing teams, and chase the contributions that make it worth visiting.

* **Coordinate AI content for the external website and corporate channels** – gather and quality-assure input from the AI teams, propose what should be told publicly, and work with Communications, who own publication.

* **Sync a shared communication calendar for AI with communications** – so that announcements, launches, webinars and external moments are sequenced rather than colliding.

**Thought leadership and external presence**

Working with the Strategy function, which owns Sanoma Learning’s thought leadership agenda, to ensure AI is represented with credible substance.

* **Build and manage a pipeline of external speaking opportunities** – identify the conferences and forums worth being at, manage submissions and deadlines, and match the right internal speaker to each.

* **Prepare speakers and material** – coordinate narrative, evidence and rehearsal so that colleagues representing Sanoma Learning externally are well equipped.

* **Drive the production of white papers and publications on AI in education** – coordinate authors, source the evidence from our own initiatives, and run the process to publication with Strategy and Communications.

* **Manage relationships with research institutions and academic partners** – keep the contacts warm, track joint work, and identify where research collaboration strengthens our position.

* **Track the external conversation on AI in education** – what peers, policymakers and researchers are saying – and feed that back into the AI agenda.

**AI partnership and M&A funnel**

Owning the front end of the AI partnership pipeline, feeding the teams that own the decisions and the transactions.

* **Build and maintain the funnel of AI-related partnership and acquisition opportunities** – sourcing, structured overview, status and next steps.

* **Run first-pass screening of candidates** – what they do, how it relates to our AI direction, what a fit would look like – and prepare the material that lets leadership decide what to pursue.

* **Organise the AI-side assessment** – pull in the technical, product, privacy and compliance expertise needed to evaluate an opportunity properly, and consolidate the view.

* **Coordinate with Strategy and M&A** , and with the business owners who would take on the partnership.

* **Maintain the relationship layer with active AI partners and vendors** – cadence, follow-up and internal visibility of what each partnership is delivering.

**Leading AI initiatives and projects**

As a member of a small, flexible team, taking direct ownership of initiatives where capacity and momentum are needed.

* **Lead assigned AI initiatives and projects end to end** – scope, plan, stakeholders, delivery and closure – across the full breadth of the AI agenda.

* **Step into initiatives that need to move** – taking over, unblocking or accelerating work as priorities shift, including topics outside the communication and partnership scope.

* **Bring structure to ambiguous work** – turn broad intentions into a plan with owners, milestones and a decision path.

* **Prepare and facilitate the forums that move decisions forward** – working sessions, steering updates and executive material.

* **Represent the AI Enablement team in cross-functional programmes** where AI is one of several contributing tracks.

**How this role works with others**

Communication and thought leadership are owned by dedicated functions at Sanoma Learning, and this role does not duplicate them. Its value lies in being the AI team’s connection into those functions: supplying substance and expertise, coordinating the AI-side contributors, keeping the AI agenda sequenced and visible, and making sure opportunities are not lost because no one on the AI side was joining the dots. The success measure is that Communications and Strategy are consistently well served by AI – not that AI does their work.

  

**A successful candidate will have the following:**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

* Project management certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum) are a strong advantage.

Additional coursework or certification in AI/ML, communications, or digital transformation is a plus.  



**Experience**

* 4+ years of professional experience in project, programme or initiative management in a digital, technology or innovation context, with at least 2 years connected to AI, data or digital transformation topics.

* Demonstrated experience in corporate or B2B communication – for example newsletters, webinars, content platforms, website content or campaign coordination – working with or within a communications function.

* Experience preparing executive-level and external-facing material, and supporting senior colleagues in representing the organisation publicly.

* Exposure to partnership management, vendor evaluation, corporate development or M&A support activities.

* Experience working across multiple stakeholders and business units, preferably in multi-country or federated environments.

* Familiarity with AI concepts and the current AI landscape, sufficient to translate technical work into language a business or public audience understands.

* Hands-on experience with collaboration and project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, SharePoint) and with content or intranet platforms.

Experience in education, publishing or EdTech, or with research institutions, is a plus.  



**Skills**

* Excellent written communication in English – able to turn technical and strategic material into clear, engaging content for different audiences.

* Strong stakeholder management, comfortable working as a connector between a specialist team and central functions without owning either side.

* Solid project management skills, able to run several parallel tracks with clarity on ownership, deadlines and status.

* Sound understanding of AI and data concepts, and the curiosity to keep that understanding current.

* Ability to structure ambiguous problems, facilitate alignment and drive decisions across teams.

* Strong sense for what is worth telling externally, and the judgement to know what is not.

* Comfortable with documentation, editorial process and governance that keep recurring communication running reliably.

Collaborative and proactive mindset, with an ability to connect the dots across organisational silos.  



**Personal Attributes**

* Proactive and positive “can-do” attitude, demonstrating initiative and resilience.

* Comfortable operating without formal authority, building influence through reliability and usefulness to others.

* Strong organisational skills, adept at managing multiple tasks simultaneously.

* Flexible and pragmatic – willing to pick up what the team needs at a given moment.

* Data-driven decision-making approach.

* Self-motivated, consistently seeking opportunities for improvement and innovation.

Passionate about the opportunities in the Data and AI space, and about education.  



**About Sanoma Learning**

How do you prepare students for the world, engage their curiosity and inspire them to grow? That is the main question of teachers all around the world. At Sanoma Learning, it has always been our mission to help to find and develop best-in-class answers to this question. If you join us, it means that you embark on an exciting journey to help shape the future of learning for primary, secondary and vocational education. We believe that your journey is our success as a company.
  
  
Sanoma Learning is a leading K12 European learning company, operating in 12 countries. Our learning products and services enable and support teachers and schools to develop the talents of every child to reach their potential. By offering printed and digital learning content, as well as digital learning and teaching platforms for primary, secondary and vocational education, we want to grow our positive impact on learning across Europe. With over 3000 employees, we help shape the future of education for 25+ million of students.
  
  
So, are you ready to start your journey to help shape the future of learning and help teachers to support all students to reach their potential?
  
  
*Sanoma Learning is an equal opportunity employer; we are committed to inclusion and diversity, ensure equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristics.*

* Manage changes to scope, schedules and delivery requirements, ensuring that their implications are understood and agreed.

description:

* Building and optimizing a successful content-driven conversion funnel, ensuring that storytelling, formats, distribution, and audience insights work together to drive measurable conversions.

* Proficiency in English. Any other extra language is a plus.
* +5 years of experience working for a newsroom, content agency, creative agency, or digital media property.
* Strong leadership skills with a minimum of 2 years of team management experience.
* Deep passion for journalism, especially at the local level, social media, and digital marketing.
* Expertise in media mapping and the ability to collaborate with external partners (advertising agencies, media agencies, TV/Animation companies).
* Digital fluency and hands-on knowledge of the current social media landscape, including platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, etc.
* Ability to inspire creative teams and customers, strong presentation skills.
* Data-driven and business-savvy with superb writing skills and creative flair.
* Solid understanding of optimization technologies and AI-driven processes, workflow automation, and performance outcomes.
* Ability to convert content creators' economy into growth opportunities.
* Team player attitude.
* Additionally, proficiency in using WordPress, familiarity with Photoshop, Canva, and knowledge of other image/video editing software is preferred. Powerful media network contacts and connections will be highly appreciated.

  

**Why You´ll Love It Here**

  

* Attractive compensation package with room to grow.
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.
* Flexible remuneration with Cobee: meals, transport, training, and nursery support (tax-exempt).
* Payflow: option to access part of your salary in advance.
* Taxdown: help optimizing and filing your taxes.
* Private health & dental insurance with Cigna: 100% covered by Fever. You can also add your family members via flexible remuneration.
* Wellhub membership for gym and wellness access: 100% covered by Fever up to the Silver plan.
* Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons.
* Hybrid work setup: home office friendly with a central Madrid office location.
* Snacks, drinks, and fresh fruit are always available at the office.
* Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.

description:
Company Description

  

MET Retail is a new chapter for the group: bringing energy directly to households. We're building a technology-driven retail platform for power and gas, with a digital, customer-first model. One model, built to scale across Europe.

We're a small international team, and there's a lot to build. Join us on this exciting journey and you'll help shape how this company works, with real ownership from day one.

  

Job Description

  

He/She brings practical service knowledge into digital delivery: understanding customer, operational, commercial and regulatory needs, shaping how customers reach us and how we respond, and building a support function that is fast, compliant, measurable and AI-assisted by design rather than by retrofit.

The role covers the customer-facing layer of the end-to-end journey (from contracting to first bill, collection and service) across the contact channels, self-service area and support tooling. Spain at launch, followed by other markets such as France, Germany and Italy. The person in this role will own customer ticketing and service, customer engagement, the continuous optimisation of support including its tools, and claim management, end to end.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the business reference point for customer service, engagement and claims across the Spanish operation and, subsequently, the markets that follow
* Translate customer and regulatory objectives into clear service processes, procedures, service levels and quality standards
* Design the omnichannel service model across phone, email, chat, WhatsApp, app and self-service portal
* Build the ticketing operation: taxonomy, routing and prioritisation rules, SLA framework, escalation paths, and shift and capacity planning
* Design proactive lifecycle communications: onboarding, first-bill explanation, consumption and tariff alerts, renewal and price-change notifications, and payment reminders
* Own the service side of retention — save flows, churn-signal detection and the operational response to them.
* Build the claims process end to end
* Ensure compliance with statutory response deadlines and the formal complaint framework, including complaint forms, consumer arbitration boards and regional consumer authorities
* Act as business owner for the support stack — CRM and ticketing, telephony/CCaaS, knowledge base, survey and QA tooling: define functional requirements, target design and evaluation criteria, support the IT organisation in vendor and partner selection, and drive business validation before go-live
* Hire, structure and lead the customer operations team; define roles, career paths, training curriculum and onboarding
* Identify, prioritise and specify AI use cases across the support chain
* Collaborate across Growth, Offering, Operations and Finance on the business side, and Product, UX, Architecture, Engineering and Data on the delivery side

  

Qualifications

  

* University degree
* **Energy retail background is a must**
* Between 5 and 10 years of experience in customer operations, service management or contact centre leadership in a B2C environment, including hands-on responsibility for building or substantially rebuilding a service function
* Experience in the Spanish market, with a working understanding of Spanish consumer protection obligations and the formal complaints and arbitration framework
* Proven experience setting up processes, procedures and teams from scratch, including defining the requirements for the supporting tooling
* Demonstrable, practical experience applying AI in a customer support context
* Comfortable in a CRM or ticketing environment, able to read data models, define integration requirements at functional level and build reporting
* Track record of leading, growing and developing teams
* Fluent Spanish and English, written and spoken. Italian, French or German language skills considered as a plus
* Experience in one or more other European markets — France, Germany or Italy in particular is highly appreciated
* Experience specifying and rolling out a support stack as business owner (Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, Freshdesk, Intercom, Genesys, Talkdesk or similar) is highly appreciated
* Experience in a high-volume regulated B2C environment — utilities, telecommunications, insurance, financial services or e-commerce — is highly appreciated
* Experience managing BPO partners in Spain or nearshore, and workforce management or forecasting experience, is a plus
* Experience with collaboration and documentation tools such as Jira, Confluence, Miro, Visio, Signavio or BPMN tools is an advantage

  

Additional Information

title: Multi-Domain Technology Demonstrator Manager
description:
**Job Description:**

We are looking for a key player to transform our technological roadmaps into reality. If you are passionate about managing complex System of Systems (SoS) architectures and bringing disruptive, multi-domain technologies to life, this role offers the perfect platform to make a high-impact contribution to the future of vertical flight.

The position is functionally attached to the Head of Engineering Spain (EBST) and reports operationally to the Research and Innovation Leader in Spain (ETR).

**Your working environment:**
-----------------------------

You will be based in Getafe, co-located with other divisions of the Airbus Group to foster cross-divisional synergies, and you will maintain close contact with AH teams in Albacete. You will interact regularly with all other organisations of Engineering and Airbus Helicopters, and coordinate a highly complex ecosystem of external stakeholders, including key government entities and public authorities.

**Your challenges:**
--------------------

* **Project Leadership & Public Funding:** Drive the end-to-end technical, programmatic, and planning execution of high-value multi-domain demonstrators up to TRL 6-7. title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Who we are**

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world’s largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organisation at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society.

To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jLJ7ZO3wOW4

**About the Role**:

Frontiers is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own a defined product, platform, or workflow area within our publishing ecosystem. The exact domain — submission, peer review, production, partnerships, AI, or another area — will be confirmed at the offer stage based on where the business need and the candidate's strengths best align. This description sets the bar and shape of the role common to all our Senior PM positions, so that candidates can be assessed once and matched to the right opening.

You will own your product end to end: understanding user and business needs, defining the roadmap, working with engineering, design and operational stakeholders to ship it, and being accountable for the outcomes it produces. You will operate within Frontiers' one-platform strategy — favouring shared, scalable workflows over bespoke, one-off solutions — regardless of which domain you land in.

You will not wait for a perfect brief. You will spot the problem, make a call with the data you have, and go find the rest. We want someone who treats a blocker as a puzzle to solve, not a reason to pause.

Key Responsibilities

* Roadmap ownership: Define and drive the roadmap for your product area, balancing user needs, business priorities, and platform constraints into a clear, sequenced plan.
* Requirements discipline: Gather, document, and reconcile requirements from multiple stakeholders — internal teams, partners, or end users — into a coherent, scalable product definition rather than a pile of one-off requests.
* Cross-team delivery: Work with and through engineering, design, and other product teams to ship your roadmap, tracking dependencies and resolving conflicts without necessarily having direct authority over every team involved.
* User- and stakeholder-facing discovery: Engage directly with the people who use or depend on your product — authors, editors, reviewers, partners, or internal teams — to uncover real underlying needs and validate that proposed solutions solve them.
* Creative, pragmatic solutioning: Where requirements conflict with simplicity or scale, propose solutions — configuration over customisation, shared workflows over bespoke branches — that satisfy the intent without fragmenting the platform.
* Evidence-led decisions: Steer your roadmap with data: define the metrics that matter for your area, track them, and show what you measured, what you changed, and what moved. Be ready to change course when the data says you were wrong.
* Quality and risk ownership: Hold the bar for whatever your product area delivers, and manage risk transparently when timelines, dependencies, or stakeholder expectations are under pressure. Define acceptance criteria, test with real users before release, and own post-launch quality.
* Product vision: Set a clear vision for your product area and connect it to Frontiers' one-platform strategy, so every roadmap choice traces back to a purpose.
* Business outcome ownership: Build and defend the business case for your product. Set the investment, expected return and payback, and answer for whether it was worth it.
* Team leadership: Lead your squad of engineers, designers and analysts toward shared goals. Coach, set direction and raise the bar, even without formal reporting lines.
* Managing up: Give the Head of Product and senior leadership regular, candid updates on progress, risks and trade-offs. Bring a recommendation with each decision you need.
* AI and automation: Find where AI agents and automation can remove manual work or improve outcomes in your area. Then scope, ship and measure them.
* Launch and adoption: Take your product from idea through launch to adoption. Plan rollout, train users, then track usage and iterate until the outcome moves.
* Resourceful problem-solving: When data, access or alignment is missing, say what you need, from whom and how you will get it. Keep moving in the meantime.

  
**Requirements**  

* Clarity of thought: You think critically and bring structure and clear rationale to ambiguous, cross-domain problems.
* Experience: 5+ years in Product Management, ideally including ownership of a multi-stakeholder, operations-heavy, or platform-level product.
* Requirements practitioner: Proven ability to gather, document, and unify requirements from multiple demanding stakeholders into a coherent product definition.
* Technical literacy: Comfortable discussing workflows, data, and system design with engineers, and reading the evidence behind a problem, without needing to be a domain specialist on day one.
* User-centric design: A track record of turning a complex process into an experience that different types of users can complete with confidence.
* Cross-team influence: Experience delivering through other teams and aligning multiple roadmaps toward a shared outcome, including without direct authority over every team involved.
* Outcomes: You can point to what you measured, what you changed, and what moved as a result of your product work.
* Ownership and agency: You take responsibility without being asked. When you hit an obstacle, you ask "how do I get this done?" and propose a path. You treat mistakes as information and move on quickly.
* Domain exposure: Background in academic publishing, SaaS platforms, multi-tenant B2B products, or AI/ML products is a plus, but strong learning agility can substitute for direct domain experience.

  
**Benefits**  

* We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
* Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
* Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
* 24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
* Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub
* Competitive local benefits country dependent (e.g. healthcare and pension/retirement provision)

*Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination – including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.*

Further, in conjunction with Research and Development, you will help support the future pipeline direction utilizing your deep understanding of the needs of customer segments and motivators that drive behavior.

Bachelor’s Degree

* Minimum of 10-15 years of broad work experience in marketing, product management, leadership, and related sales support activities.
* Experience leading teams from diverse countries and business backgrounds.
* Skilled in navigating and influencing within an international matrix organization, driving rapid growth, and elevating market position, aligned with global and regional objectives.
* Demonstrated marketing experience of global product launches with measured results with set of clear metrics.
* Experience managing multimillion-dollar budgets across multiple initiatives.
* Marketing acumen and experience within new product planning and brand positioning.
* Strong ability to plan and manage marketing planning workflow.
* Familiarity of the Animal Health or related industry, marketing, and commercial Operations. Familiarity with the vaccine business is a plus.

para

title: Head of Marketing, B2B Payments
description:
**About Rebill**
Rebill is the financial infrastructure platform for the Americas.
  
  
The companies shaping software, AI, travel, and digital services use Rebill to operate across Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and the United States.
  
  
Rebill brings local payments, installments, recurring billing, stablecoin rails, treasury, global payouts, and financial operations into one platform built for how money actually works across the Americas.
  
  
Every market is different. Rebill makes the infrastructure consistent. Engineering, finance, and operations teams can manage local currency acceptance, market-specific payment behavior, funds, and financial workflows from the same platform.
  
  
Companies can launch in Latin America in as little as a day and expand across markets without rebuilding their financial stack country by country.
  
  
Built locally. Designed to scale globally.
  
  
Rebill is backed by leading global investors such as Tiger Global, Y Combinator (W22), Soma Capital and SV Angel, and angels including Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and Arash Ferdowsi (Dropbox).
  
  
Why this role exists
  
  
Our product is ahead of our brand.
  
  
We show up in evaluations against the large regional processors. In too many of them we are not in the room at all, and in the ones where we are, we read as earlier stage than we are. A company about to route its regional volume through us needs to see infrastructure, not a startup. That gap costs us deals we should be winning on product.
  
  
At the same time, every piece of marketing we do today is run by the founders in the gaps between other jobs: the ads, the SEO, the content, the launches, the events. It holds at twelve people. It will not hold through the next stage.
  
  
This role owns both.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Brand and positioning. One story about what Rebill is and why it matters, decided once and held everywhere: the site, the deck, the product, the sales calls. There are four versions of it today. The harder half of this is moving Rebill from looking like a startup to being credible to a bank, a public company or a regulated buyer, and doing it without losing the reason people like working with us. Visual identity and the standard of every surface that carries our name are part of the job.
* Product marketing. Our product is technical and our buyer gets more sophisticated every quarter. Someone has to turn what engineering ships into something a CFO or a VP of Finance understands and acts on: launches with a real process behind them, sales material that shortens a cycle instead of decorating it, and airtime for the people building it.
* Content and distribution. Build the publishing engine: site, blog, LinkedIn, press, and the organic surface that AI assistants cite when someone asks how to collect across Latin America. Content goes out in English first and gets localized per market after.
* Events and founder positioning. Own the calendar and the outcome, from Money20/20 and Febraban class shows down to dinners for fifteen people that move one account. Booth, content, capture, follow-up, and the discipline of cross-referencing scanned leads against the CRM so we know what was net new and which opportunities we influenced. The bar is that events pay for themselves and that you can show it. You will also get our founders onto the right stages and make them better once they are up there.
* Demand generation. Campaigns, paid, funnel instrumentation and the loop back to sales. You inherit what the founders run today, starting with Google Ads and SEO.
* Ecosystem. Accelerators, communities, partner co-marketing and the Y Combinator network.

**What We Are Looking For**

* You work inside a technology company today, or did until recently, and someone else paid for that learning curve. Rebill is not where you find out how software gets built and sold. Payments or fintech in Latin America is where our strongest candidates come from. Failing that, a technical B2B category with a sophisticated buyer and a long sales cycle. If your career is in agencies, consulting or consumer brands, this is not the role.
* You have sold to companies, not consumers. You know what a long enterprise cycle feels like from the inside and what actually counts as proof inside one.
* You have run marketing across several countries from one seat. Not one market with regional support. Several markets with different payment cultures, different press and different buyers, with a team you could count on one hand.
* Your career passed through more than one discipline. The people who are best at this job have some combination of classical brand work, where owning a brand meant owning a business, hands-on paid media, and time spent close to product. One lane is not enough here. Two or three is what makes the difference.
* You are hands-on. You write the copy, brief the designer, build the deck and pull the numbers yourself. For the first stretch there is nobody to hand it to.
* You write English at a level that does not need editing, and you present in English and Spanish. Our content is English first.

You use AI tools every day and it is visible in how much you ship and how good it is.
  
  
**Nice to have**

* Portuguese. Brazil is a priority market and we invest there.
* You have taken a company through the move from looking like a startup to being credible to a regulated buyer, and you remember what actually shifted it.
* Press and analyst relations in payments or fintech.
* Ownership of a booth or a program at an event the size of Money20/20 or Febraban.
* You have managed a designer or an agency and held visual consistency across markets.
* A real network in the Latin American fintech ecosystem: accelerators, communities, funds, operators.

**What Success Looks Like**
In the first 90 days there is one version of our story and everyone uses it. The site, the deck and the sales team say the same thing, and you can explain in one paragraph why a company should route its regional volume through us.
  
  
By six months there is a content engine publishing in English with a localization path, launches have a process attached to them, and our events are measured against pipeline instead of against how the booth felt.
  
  
By twelve months, when a mid-market or enterprise company in the Americas starts looking for a way to collect across the region, we are on the shortlist. Marketing sources a measurable share of new pipeline and you know which share and why.
  
  
**What This Role Is Not**
There is no team to inherit. You are the marketing function for the first stretch, and you hire in the second year, not the first.
  
  
The founders stay the public faces of Rebill. We want you to make us better at that and to build a brand that outlasts us doing it. We are not looking for someone to be the voice instead of us.
  
  
We keep marketing in-house. We use agencies for specific pieces, press and visual identity among them, and we do not hand anyone the brand.
  
  
You report to the co-founders, and you will spend your first months earning credibility with people who have never worked alongside a marketing function. That is part of the job and not a sign that it is going badly.
  
  
**Compensation**
Competitive base, meaningful equity, and the scope of a founding function. Hybrid in Buenos Aires, Bogotá or Miami. Remote from Mexico City or São Paulo, with regular time in one of our offices. Travel for events and offsites.

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major and 4 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising experience preferred

OR

* Executes annual marketing plan to budget, in consultation with the GM, Food and Beverage leader, Operations leaders, Director of Marketing Communications, and cluster marketing and ecommerce teams.

title: Head of Video
description:
**We're hiring: Head of Video – Ramos Real Estate Dubai**

Lead the visual identity of a growing real estate and property tech group.

For four years, Ramos Real Estate has helped clients invest in Dubai property, with a strong focus on off-plan projects and international buyers, especially from Nigeria. We're growing fast alongside our sister company, Expert Listing, a property platform built for Nigeria.

We're looking for a talented video editor and shooter to own our content from idea to final cut. This isn't a "shoot what you're told" role. You'll shape how our brand looks, sounds and feels across every platform.

**What you'll own**

* Our video style and direction across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Facebook
* Shooting property tours, off-plan launches, show units, drone and lifestyle footage across Dubai
* Editing high-quality short-form and long-form videos, including faceless content with voice-overs, motion graphics and captions
* A monthly plan of 20+ finished videos, created with our marketing team
* Tracking what performs and using the data to improve each month's content

**What success looks like**

* 20+ finished videos delivered every month
* Edits turned around within 48 hours of a shoot
* Content that grows our reach, engagement and buyer enquiries month on month

**What we're looking for**

* A strong showreel with real estate, luxury, architecture or lifestyle content
* Advanced editing skills in Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut
* Confidence shooting with mirrorless cameras, gimbals and audio equipment
* A sharp eye for storytelling, pacing and social media trends
* Ability to work independently and deliver on time
* Based in Dubai

**What we offer**

* Salary: AED 5,000–7,000 per month, depending on experience
* Monthly performance bonus for hitting delivery and results targets
* Bonus when a lead from your content turns into a closed sale
* Guaranteed salary review after 3 months
* Creative freedom to define the brand's visual style
* Flexible working: edit remotely between shoots
* Camera, gimbal and audio kit provided
* A clear path to lead content across two growing companies

**How to apply**

Send your CV and portfolio or showreel to info@ramosrealestatedubai.com with the subject line "Head of Video – [Your Name]."

In your email, include a short note describing one real estate video you'd create for us.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid test edit, and we aim to make a decision within one week. Applications without a CV, portfolio and video idea won't be considered.

title: Director of Design
description:
About Mendocino Farms
  
At Mendocino Farms, we do a lot more than just sell sandwiches and salads. We are a fast-casual restaurant brand on a mission to bring people together through fresh, culinary-driven food and unmatched hospitality. As we continue our aggressive growth trajectory across new and existing markets, we are seeking a dynamic, analytical, and hands-on leader to elevate our total rewards structure.
  
Our Core Values and Mantras
  

* Sell Happy: The foundational philosophy that goes beyond serving meals to actively uplifting and improving every guest's day.
* Food Should Make People Feel Good: A commitment to using high-quality, whole, and thoughtfully sourced ingredients that make eating well easy.
* Be Culinary Explorers: A passion for combining fresh ingredients and bold flavors in unexpected, gourmet ways.
* Turn the Ordinary into the Extraordinary: Treating every customer and team interaction as a chance to lift someone's spirits.
* Get Better Every Day (GBED): An internal mantra encouraging continuous learning, personal growth, and skill development.

**Job Title:** Director of Design
  
**Reports To:** VP, Design & Construction
  
**Location:** Dallas, TX or Remote, USA
  
**Salary Range:** $117k - $190k (Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location.)
  
  
**Summary:**  
Mendocino Farms is seeking a Director of Design to lead the evolution and delivery of our restaurant experience across new restaurants, remodels, refreshes, and strategic initiatives.
  
**This leader will own Mendo’s design function:** the restaurant prototype, design standards, internal and external design resources, and the systems that turn brand strategy into distinctive, functional, and scalable restaurants. You will partner closely with Operations, Culinary, Facilities, Construction, Real Estate, and Marketing to create environments that strengthen the guest experience while supporting efficient operations, disciplined investment, and growth.
  
This is an opportunity for a creative and operationally minded leader who can set a compelling design point of view, build a high-performing team and consultant network, and make practical decisions that balance quality, durability, speed, cost, and long-term unit performance as Mendocino Farms expands its restaurant footprint.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  
Lead the design function
  

* Lead, coach, and develop internal designers and external design resources; set clear expectations, effective working rhythms, and a high bar for quality and accountability.
* Align internal and external design resources to the development pipeline, identifying when specialized expertise is needed.
* Serve as the senior design leader for complex, high-visibility, or high-risk projects and decisions.

Own the brand environment and design standards
  

* Own and evolve Mendo’s restaurant prototype, design standards, material palettes, finishes, furniture, fixtures, lighting, equipment integration, and reusable design details.
* Ensure every restaurant delivers a recognizable Mendo experience while adapting appropriately to site conditions, market needs, and business priorities.
* Use operating feedback, field learning, and market insight to keep the brand environment relevant, differentiated, and scalable.
* Set and elevate Mendo’s creative design point of view, translating brand strategy into memorable, functional restaurant environments that feel distinctive across markets and formats.

Improve restaurant operations through design
  

* Maintain and evolve design standards that prioritize guest flow, ordering and pickup, digital and delivery activity, seating, accessibility, storage, serviceability, and day-to-day operations.
* Partner with Operations, Culinary, Facilities, Construction, and equipment vendors to improve kitchen planning, back-of-house flow, equipment integration, team ergonomics, throughput, food safety, and maintainability.
* Incorporate post-opening learning into future layouts, prototypes, and specifications.

Drive quality, clarity, and design delivery
  

* Oversee design delivery for new restaurants, remodels, and refresh programs from feasibility test fits and concepts through permit-ready documentation and design-related construction support.
* Establish practical design QA/QC and phase-gate practices that produce complete, coordinated, code-aware, and timely deliverables.
* Lead cross-functional reviews using clear agendas, advance pre-reads, recommendations, concise decision requests, and thoroughly documented follow-through.
* Translate stakeholder input into clear direction for internal teams and consultants, surfacing risks and tradeoffs early.
* Partner with Construction to protect design intent, improve constructability, and reduce design-related rework, RFIs, and change orders.

Manage partners and investment decisions
  

* Select, brief, manage, and evaluate architects, interior designers, engineers, and specialty vendors; set clear expectations for scope, quality, timing, communication, and accountability.
* Partner with Construction and Real Estate to understand design cost drivers and make value-engineering recommendations.
* Balance brand expression, operating performance, durability, cost, schedule, and long-term unit economics in design and specification decisions.
* Track design-function performance, capacity, risks, and priorities; use post-project reviews to improve standards, tools, and partner performance.
* Develop the annual design operating plan in partnership with Real Estate, including internal and consultant capacity, priorities, budget needs, and key risks; provide regular updates on design delivery.

How you’ll lead at Mendo
  
You lead with ownership, preparation, sound judgment, and a continuous-improvement mindset. You develop people and partners, create alignment through clear communication and decision-making, navigate tradeoffs constructively, and build confidence through reliable follow-through.
  
  
**What you’ll bring:**  

* 10+ years of progressive experience in restaurant, retail, hospitality, architecture, interior design, or another related built-environment discipline.
* Experience leading a design team, studio, function, or substantial network of external design partners in a fast-moving, multi-project environment.
* Significant hands-on experience with restaurant or similarly operationally intensive commercial design, including prototype development, new-unit growth, remodels, and site-specific adaptation.
* Strong command of restaurant operations and design, including FOH/BOH flow, kitchen equipment, labor and ergonomics, guest circulation and accessibility, pickup/delivery, food safety, storage, and maintainability.
* Experience managing architects, interior designers, engineers, and specialty vendors against quality, schedule, scope, and budget expectations.
* Working knowledge of construction documentation, design QA/QC, permitting, building and health codes, design detailing, accessibility, shop-drawing review, and constructability.
* Financial fluency with design budgets, cost drivers, value engineering, specification tradeoffs, lifecycle durability, and unit economics.
* Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Interior Architecture, Interior Design, Environmental Design, Product Design, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Proficiency with Bluebeam Revu, Excel, PowerPoint, and project-management platforms; working knowledge of AutoCAD and/or Revit and SketchUp is preferred.
* Exceptional written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including the ability to develop concise recommendations and executive-ready presentations.
* Ability to travel occasionally for market visits, project milestones, and team meetings.

**Benefits include:**  

* Competitive salary
* Meal privileges
* Health benefits
* 401k Plan
* Paid Vacation

Physical Requirements
  

* Must be able to lift 25 pounds.
* Sitting / standing 6-8 hours.
* Hand use: single grasping, fine manipulation, pushing and pulling
* Work requires the following motions: bending, twisting, squatting and reaching

There is no “I” in Mendo
  
Mendocino Farms is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. Mendocino Farms will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring.

Mendocino Farms is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Fractional Media Director
description:
**Overview**

We are seeking an autonomous, business-minded **Media Director** to take comprehensive ownership of our annual **$20M media budget**. As a $200-$250M omnichannel brand scaling rapidly, we are moving beyond pure-play performance to build a sophisticated, full-funnel media engine.

In this role, you will operate as a high-leverage individual contributor. Instead of managing a large internal team, you will wield full strategic control over media allocation and agency partners. You will be responsible for balancing traditional **DTC conversion media**, deploying our new **brand awareness initiatives**, and maximizing our presence across our core Retail Media Networks: **Amazon** and **Target**. Additionally, you will support us in hiring the right media agency/partner.

**Duties**

**1. Full Media Budget Ownership & Capital Allocation**

* Serve as the sole financial steward for the $XM media budget, fluidly shifting capital between performance, brand, and retail channels to maximize overall enterprise growth.
* Lead comprehensive media planning and scenario-modeling to present direct spending recommendations to executive leadership.

**2. Retail Media Network (RMN) Mastery (Amazon & Target)**

* Drive omni-channel velocity by building and scaling ad strategies on **Amazon Advertising** (Sponsored Ads, DSP) and **Target Roundel**.
* Align digital media plans with retail trade calendars to ensure digital media spend directly boosts physical shelf velocity and online market share.

**3. Full-Funnel Brand Awareness Strategy**

* Own the strategy, deployment, and optimization of upper-funnel brand equity campaigns across Connected TV (CTV), Digital Audio, Linear, and Programmatic video.
* Establish and track upper-funnel success metrics via brand lift studies, tracking share of voice (SOV), and baseline organic search growth.

**4. DTC Conversion & Performance Media**

* Maintain the efficiency of core performance channels (Meta, Google, TikTok) focusing on Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Lifetime Value (LTV), and Blended Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER). Recognizing this is the core of media planning and strategy today, this will be a strong foundation shift.
* Partner with internal creative teams to guide rapid asset testing based on performance data trends.

**5. High-Impact Agency Governance**

* Directly manage external media planning, buying, and performance agencies, acting as their primary point of contact and holding them to strict execution standards.
* Audit agency work continuously to eliminate media waste and ensure data-driven campaign optimizations.

**6. Advanced Attribution & Holistic Measurement**

* Partner with Data Analytics to interpret Media Mix Modeling (MMM) and Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA) readouts.
* Quantify the "halo effect" of brand and retail media spending on our direct-to-consumer website traffic and sales.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 5–8 years of experience overseeing omnichannel media strategy, either brand-side or at a leading growth agency.
* **Budget Scale:** Direct experience managing or heavily influencing media budgets of **$20M+ annually**.
* **RMN Specialization:** Proven, deep expertise navigating **Amazon Advertising** and **Target Roundel** ecosystems.
* **Individual Contributor DNA:** Thrives as a self-directed operator who can command a $50M budget and steer agencies without needing a large internal team to delegate to.
* **Full-Funnel Native:** Demonstrated success deploying and measuring upper-funnel, non-linear brand awareness campaigns.
* **Analytical Rigor:** Highly proficient in interpreting MMM data, Google Analytics 4, and multi-retailer dashboard metrics.

Join us as a Fractional Media Director if you're ready to bring your strategic vision to life through impactful storytelling, innovative media outreach, and engaging digital campaigns!

Pay: From $150.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

title: Director, Product Design
description:
**About the role**
------------------

Cyberhaven is building Flow, a unified data security platform spanning Human Data Security, Agentic Data Security, and Data Security Posture Management. The people who use it are security analysts, insider-risk investigators, and data protection leaders — experts doing demanding work under time pressure, who live in our product all day. And increasingly they are not working alone: AI agents are becoming actors inside the enterprise and inside our product, which means the experience we design now has to serve both the human doing the judging and the agent doing the work.

We are looking for a Director of Product Design to lead our design team and own what Flow feels like to use. You will set the experience vision for the platform, define the interaction patterns for a generation of security work that is part human and part agentic, and lead the designers and researchers who make it real.

You will lead a small, talented team of designers and will partner directly with the CPO, product management, engineering, and customer experience, and you will operate as the design voice in the rooms where the roadmap and scope get decided. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will raise the craft bar and grow your team, and still be close enough to the work to have an independent point of view about what we should build.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the end-to-end product design experience across Flow, HDS, ADS, and DSPM from the analyst’s daily workflow to how the platform holds together as one product rather than three.
* Define the next-generation experience vision for the platform, including how humans and AI agents work together inside it: agent-assisted investigation, human-in-the-loop decisions, explainability, and the interaction patterns that let a security professional trust and override automated work.
* Lead, coach, and grow a team of product designers, and raise the standard for craft, critique, and how design decisions are argued and defended.
* Own the UX research function and make sure the team’s work is grounded in evidence customer interviews, usability testing, support and RFE signal, and product instrumentation rather than internal opinion.
* Partner with product management and engineering from the earliest stage of every major initiative, shaping the problem definition and scope rather than styling decisions that have already been made.
* Build and evolve the design system and the patterns that let a growing engineering organization ship a consistent experience at speed.
* Establish how design measures itself usability benchmarks, task success, time to resolution for core analyst workflows, adoption of new surfaces, support deflection and report against it.
* Drive the experience work behind platform migration, making sure the move to Flow is something customers want rather than something they endure.
* Represent the customer’s experience in executive forums roadmap reviews, business reviews, and planning with a clear and honest read on where the product stands.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 10+ years in product design, including 4+ years leading and developing designers, with a portfolio of shipped work you can walk through end to end.
* You have set an experience vision for a complex product and then delivered against it — not just a concept deck, but patterns and surfaces that shipped and held up.
* Experienced with complex, expert-user enterprise software — tools where the user is a professional doing demanding work, not a consumer. Security, IT operations, observability, data infrastructure, or similar domains.
* You have designed AI-powered or agentic product experiences and have a real point of view on trust, transparency, control, and what happens when the model is wrong.
* Strong systems thinker: you can hold a platform-level information architecture in your head, and you build design systems that make teams faster instead of slowing them down.
* You value and use research. You know how to run the function, ask the right questions of it, and act on what comes back.
* An exceptional communicator and influencer. You can tell a room of executives something they do not want to hear, ground it in the customer’s reality, and leave with a decision.
* A people leader first. You develop designers, give direct feedback, and build a team that does its best work.
* You operate with urgency and judgment in a fast-moving environment, and you are comfortable making progress before every input is in hand.
* Located in the US (SF Bay Area preferred).

**Bonus points if you have:**

* Worked in cybersecurity, or designed for security operations, insider risk, or data protection teams.
* Led design through a major platform migration or the consolidation of several products into one.
* Experience building a design function hiring, leveling, process, and the operating rhythm not just running one that already existed.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.  
Backed by $250M from leading investors like Khosla and Redpoint, our team includes leaders who built industry-defining technologies at CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Meta, Google, and more. This role lets you shape the future of data security, working alongside people driven to protect workflows, not just data, for customers who cannot afford to slow down to stay safe.

The AI Tools may process information you provide during the application and interview process. When AI-assisted interview note taking is used, candidates are notified in advance and have the option to opt out of the AI-assisted interview note taking.

*Cyberhaven is committed to creating a diverse environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.*

description:

The Fractional Media Director serves as the senior strategic leader for Phase 3’s media practice, providing integrated media strategy, senior client counsel, team leadership and guidance on emerging channels and opportunities.  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for an experienced agency media professional who can move comfortably between high-level strategy, client conversations, team development and campaign oversight. title: Director, Global Trade Compliance
description:
**Overview of Position**

  

Reporting to the AVP, Connected Living Compliance, this position is responsible for leading Assurant's global trade compliance program and ensuring compliance with all applicable import, export, sanctions, and customs regulations. In addition to enterprise related trade activities, this role actively supports the movement of mobile devices, device components, service parts, accessories, and related technologies across global markets while enabling efficient customer, carrier, OEM, repair, refurbishment, and logistics operations.

  
  

The Director serves as a strategic advisor to Connected Living leadership and business stakeholders, balancing compliance obligations with customer commitments, operational efficiency, and commercial objectives.

  
  

This role will also partner, coordinate, and align global trade compliance activities and strategies with the Director, Global Supply Chain Compliance.

  
  

**What will my duties and responsibilities be in this job?**

  

**Global Trade Compliance Leadership (45%)**

  

* Develop, implement, and continuously improve Assurant's global trade compliance program.
* Establish governance, policies, procedures, and internal controls covering import, export, sanctions, and customs compliance.
* Ensure compliance with:
  + U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR)
  + OFAC sanctions requirements
  + U.S. Customs regulations
  + International customs laws and regulations
  + Foreign trade regulations in countries where Assurant operates
* Provide strategic guidance to executive leadership on global trade risks and opportunities.
* Identify and implement value-creation opportunities, including duty drawback, free trade agreements, foreign trade zones, tariff engineering, and other lawful duty mitigation strategies.

**Import Compliance and Customs Management (20%)**

  

* Oversee global customs compliance for mobile devices, service parts, accessories, and technology.
* Ensure accurate:
  + HTS classifications
  + Country-of-origin determinations
  + Customs valuation
  + Duty assessment
* Manage customs brokers and trade service providers.
  + Identify and implement duty savings strategies and opportunities.
* Support optimization of global supply chain costs and customs efficiency.
  

  

**Export Controls and Sanctions Compliance (20%)**

  

* Oversee export classification activities for devices, components, software, and technology.
* Ensure compliance with export controls.
* Lead restricted-party screening and sanctions compliance programs.
* Provide guidance regarding cross-border shipments, technology transfers, and international business transactions.
* Manage export licensing requirements and government authorizations when required.
* Drive global alignment for HTS classification, country of origin, customs valuation, and Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) determinations.
* Maintain awareness of export-controlled technology, software, encryption, and restricted-access information requirements applicable to Assurant operations.
* Assess and manage export control risks involving restricted destinations, restricted parties, military end users, military end uses, and controlled technologies, software, or technical data; develop procedures for end-use/end-user due diligence, escalation, licensing analysis, and transaction holds where required.

**Risk Management and Compliance Governance (10%)**

  

* Conduct enterprise-wide trade compliance risk assessments.
* Develop and maintain trade compliance controls and monitoring programs.
* Lead internal audits and compliance reviews.
* Establish compliance metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting.
* Investigate compliance incidents and manage corrective actions.
* Lead government audits, inquiries, disclosures, and remediation activities.

* Assists in remediating trade compliance issues as necessary, including but not limited to putting together project plans, connecting resources to find solutions, documenting resolutions, and documenting remediation plans.
* Supports internal compliance audits and assists with managing external audits or inquiries from government agencies Maintains accurate data and recordkeeping to include collecting and retaining records in response to third-party inquiries relating to Assurant compliance practices and business activities.

**Training and Culture (5%)**

  

* Develop and deliver trade compliance training and awareness programs.
* Ensure employees understand their responsibilities related to international trade activities.
* Maintain training records and support audit readiness.
  

  

**Number of Direct Reports**

  

* 1-2 including a Compliance Analyst
  

  

**Financial Responsibility**

  

* Signoff on responsible expenses, input on annual budget.
  

  

**What are the requirements needed for this position?**

  

**Experience**

  

* Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in global trade compliance.
* At least 5 years of leadership experience.
* Experience supporting multinational import/export operations.
* Experience managing customs and export compliance programs.
* Experience supporting technology, telecommunications, consumer electronics, mobile device, repair/refurbishment, or logistics industries preferred.

  

**Education & Certifications**

  

* Bachelors’ degree required, Master’s or JD preferred

**Preferred Certifications**

  

* Licensed Customs Broker (LCB)
* Certified Export Specialist (CES)
* Certified Customs Specialist (CCS)

* Certified U.S. Export Compliance Officer (CUSECO)
  

  

**Preferred Technical Expertise**

  

* EAR
* OFAC sanctions compliance
* Customs valuation
* HTS classification
* Country-of-origin analysis
* Free Trade Agreements
* Duty drawback
* Foreign Trade Zones (FTZ)
* Reverse logistics operations
* Mobile device repair and refurbishment supply chains
  

  

**Leadership Competencies**

The candidate will be able to provide examples of successfully demonstrating the following leadership competencies:

  
  

* Internal client-orientation with a constructive approach to resolution of issues. A style which builds alliances within the organization.
* Ability to establish credibility with business owners, including senior and executive leadership, and influence through professional communication, work product, etc.
* Solutions-oriented, demonstrated growth mindset.
* Proven ability to build and maintain effective cross-functional relationships with clients, colleagues and stakeholders of various levels and areas throughout the organization.
* Ability to lead change efforts through effective communication and persuasion.
* Creative, resilient, and flexible style and approach to handling complex issues with high tolerance for ambiguity
* Demonstrated leadership experience on leveraging data to drive actionable insights for risk or compliance programs
* Clear written, visual and verbal communication skills, including ability to adjust messages dependent on audiences ranging from front-line employees to executive
* Cultural competency and executive-level presence to work with the business and regional leadership teams around the world
* Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and follow-up skills. Ability to interpret rules and guidelines, and then conceptualize and implement into policies, procedures, and controls.
* Excellent and demonstrated project management skills, and attention to detail in leading projects and activities in a global organization. Ability to prioritize and simultaneously execute on multiple projects and ability to organize and analyze complex information and data
* Sound and independent judgment, and demonstrated prudence and maturity
* Commitment to driving a culture of ethics and integrity

* Cultivate a high-performing trade compliance team through coaching, mentoring, accountability, and development of trade compliance professionals.
  

  

**Skills**

  

The candidate will be able to demonstrate proficiency in the following skills:

  
  

* Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite with specific emphasis in Word, Excel, PowerPoint
* The ability to work in a fast-paced environment with several simultaneous deliverables
* Program of project management skills
  

  

**What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?**

  

* Experience in mobile or technology industries
* Ability to use AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, etc
* Supply chain and vendor risk management experience

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

**About the role**

Deepgram's Brand Marketing is growing into a collaborative Brand Studio with dedicated creative leadership, an evolving design system, and clear ways of working. We're looking for a Senior Designer who pairs strong craft with sound judgment: someone who can move work forward independently, knows when a project calls for a fresh set of eyes, and thrives in a studio where ideas are explored together. As an AI company, we're excited about how AI can expand what a small creative team can do, and we want designers who share that excitement.

You'll report to our Design Director and work closely with partners across Marketing and the wider company, turning business needs into polished, on-brand design.

**What you'll do**

* Bring big creative ideas and high impact execution. Look to push Deepgram’s creative bar and highlight the power of voice.
* Take on the full range of design work a growing brand needs, from high-profile concepts like event branding and environmental design to keynote presentations to iterative, production-focused tasks.
* Contribute to design challenges and parallel creative explorations, and fully support whichever direction the team moves forward with.
* Drive projects from brief to delivery by keeping momentum, setting milestones, identifying next steps, and surfacing risks and blockers early.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to understand their goals and requirements, then translate that context into design work aligned with Brand Studio direction.
* Execute confidently within our design system, brand guidelines, and templates, from slide decks and data tables to campaign assets.
* Recognize when work is new, high-visibility, or precedent-setting, and bring it to creative leadership for alignment at the right moment.
* Collaborate with fellow designers, contractors, and other creative resources on shared projects.
* Stay current as our design system and brand standards evolve, and help put new standards into practice.
* Use preference testing and other available data to inform design decisions.
* Use AI tools to speed up exploration, iteration, and production, from generating early concepts and variations to automating repetitive tasks, while keeping the final work to our brand and craft standards.
* Help the team try out new AI-assisted creative workflows and share what works.

**What we're looking for**

* 7+ years of experience in brand, marketing, or communication design, ideally in-house at a fast-growing technical B2B/SaaS company or relevant agency experience.
* A portfolio showing polished, production-ready work with strong typography, hierarchy, spacing, color, and attention to detail across print and digital.
* Experience working within and extending design systems and brand guidelines.
* Sound judgment about when to work independently and when to seek alignment, and comfort escalating early with context and proposed solutions.
* Strong prioritization skills and the ability to flag competing demands and trade-offs before they become problems.
* Clear, proactive communication about status, decisions, and risks.
* A collaborative mindset: you enjoy creative exploration, take feedback well, and incorporate direction accurately.
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders while keeping design direction coherent.
* Proficiency in Figma (and Figma Weave), Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator and After Effects), Presentation design software (Google slides)
* Hands-on experience with AI tools in a design workflow (for example, image generation, AI features in Figma or Adobe, or AI-assisted copy and layout), and a good sense of where they help and where human craft matters most.
* Curiosity about how AI is changing creative work, and the ability to adapt processes as the tools evolve.

**How we work**

We work as a collaborative studio. Multiple designers may explore the same problem, and projects often have several contributors. We measure success by craft, judgment, reliability, and collaboration, not by whose concept gets picked. Regular check-ins with your manager keep priorities clear and support your growth.

Compensation Range: $150K - $190K

We are seeking a Director, Consumer Digital Experience to join the Credit Acceptance marketing team, reporting to the VP of Marketing. Credit Acceptance helps people with credit challenges buy a vehicle and build a stronger financial future. This leader owns the vision for the consumer digital experience across every surface and every stage of that journey — our website, mobile app and web portal — from the first moment someone wonders whether a car is possible, through the purchase, and across the life of the loan.

The Digital Vehicle Marketplace — giving consumers the ability to shop for and purchase a vehicle online from a Credit Acceptance dealer — is the future of the company, and it will be delivered through these surfaces. This role owns all of them: the website, the app, the portal and payments, the experience standard that holds them together, and a single prioritized roadmap that decides what gets built and when.

The leaders of Consumer Acquisition and Customer Loyalty & Retention are this role’s closest partners: they bring the business opportunity and the target, and this role is accountable for the experience that delivers it. This position is a Hybrid position at our Corporate Office which is 3 days onsite and 2 days remote.

USD $180,000.00 - USD $210,000.00 /Yr.
  
  
**About Us**
OUR FOUNDER, MOMOFUKU ANDO
  
  
There is only one company that can rightfully claim the Pinnacle of Noodledom. Only one company whose founder, faced with a Japanese food shortage after WWII, invented instant ramen and sparked a 3-minute global revolution. Only one whose spirit of innovation continues to provide simple, nourishing delight to billions of people. Only one that has been loved around the world for more than 60 years. There is only one Nissin Foods.
  
  
NISSIN IN THE U.S.
  
  
On a trip to the U.S. in 1966, Mr. Ando noticed Americans curiously eating forkfuls of noodles out of cups, instead of using bowls and chopsticks. With that simple observation, the worldwide Cup Noodles® phenomenon was born. Shortly after, Nissin officially put down its roots in the U.S. In 1972, our Gardena, CA, plant started production of Top Ramen®—the first instant ramen manufactured and sold in the U.S. And ever since, Nissin Foods USA has launched a continuous stream of new and innovative products for hungry, noodle-loving Americans.
  
  
WHY NISSIN?
  
  
Nissin Foods celebrates diversity and inclusion both in our brands and how we do business. Why? Innovation is best driven by diverse perspectives, which create unique results. Respect, steady professional growth, and quality work make our team stronger. We welcome quality folks to join Team Nissin and fulfill our mission to “make people happy by creating delicious, convenient and value-oriented Asian-inspired meal solutions.” If you celebrate innovation and love noodles, you belong here!
