### **Working/Functional Title**

Associate Director of Content, MarComm

### **Position Summary**

Michigan State University is seeking an experienced editorial leader to serve as Associate Director of Content within University Advancement Marketing and Communications (UA MarComm).

Reporting to the Director of Content, the Associate Director leads the day-to-day editorial program that brings University Advancement's content strategy to life. This position manages the story pipeline, writes and develops priority content, directs editorial assignments and resources, serves as editor for Spartan magazine, alumni eNews and other primary Advancement publications, and oversees editing, copy editing, proofreading, and editorial quality across the content function.

The Associate Director supervises writers, copy editing, proofreading staff, and student writers, providing coaching, feedback, assignments, and professional development. Working closely with the Director of Content, Project Management, and other UA MarComm functions, the Associate Director translates content pillars and storytelling priorities into coordinated, high-quality content across Advancement.

This role serves as the operational editorial leader for the content team, writing and shaping high-priority stories while guiding the work of other writers and contributors. The Associate Director ensures stories move from ideas to polished execution with strong editorial judgment, consistent voice, high standards, and effective collaboration with campus partners.

**Responsibilities will include:**

**Editorial and Storytelling Management -**

* Translate University Advancement content strategy, content pillars, and storytelling priorities into an actionable editorial program and story pipeline.
* Lead day-to-day editorial planning, including developing story angles, assigning writers and editorial resources, coordinating contributors, and maintaining visibility into upcoming content needs.
* Research, interview, and write compelling content for priority Advancement stories, publications, and communications, particularly projects requiring strong editorial judgment or complex storytelling.
* Supervise, coach, and evaluate writers, copy editing, proofreading staff, and student writers, including assigning work, setting expectations, providing feedback, and supporting professional development.
* Guide stories from concept through final editorial approval, ensuring strong storytelling, audience relevance, accuracy, consistency, and alignment with Advancement priorities.
* Collaborate with writers and partners to develop story concepts, conduct interviews, and identify compelling narratives that demonstrate the impact of philanthropy and engagement.
* Identify gaps, emerging story opportunities, and resource needs and bring recommendations to the Director of Content.
* Coordinate with campus communicators, subject-matter experts, development colleagues, and other partners to gather information, shape stories, and support collaborative content development.
* Partner with Project Management on schedules, workflows, approvals, and production coordination while retaining editorial ownership of story assignments, content quality, and publication readiness.

  

**Flagship Publications and Editorial Programming -**

* Serve as editor of Spartan magazine, alumni eNews, and other primary University Advancement publications and editorial products.
* Lead editorial planning, story selection, sequencing, assignment, and review for flagship publications.
* Ensure publication content reflects Advancement priorities, audience needs, content pillars, and a balanced mix of storytelling topics and voices.
* Coordinate with Creative Strategies, Digital Marketing, Social Media, Video and Project Management to extend stories across channels and maximize their value and reach.
* Identify opportunities to repurpose, adapt, and connect content across publications and platforms rather than treating stories as one-time assets.

**Editing, Standards and Quality Assurance -**

* Provide final editorial oversight for Advancement content, including editing, copy editing, proofreading, fact checking, and quality control.
* Maintain and apply University Advancement editorial voice, AP style, MSU editorial standards, accessibility practices and inclusive communications guidance.
* Establish and continuously improve editorial review processes, style resources, templates, and quality-control practices.
* Coach writers and contributors on structure, voice, clarity, accuracy, and audience-centered storytelling.

**Staff Development and Editorial Collaboration -**

* Develop a high-performing editorial team through clear expectations, regular feedback, coaching, and professional development.
* Facilitate editorial conversations, story planning, and collaborative brainstorming that strengthen content quality and cross-team awareness.
* Support onboarding, documentation, and editorial resources that help staff and contributors work effectively and consistently.
* Partner with the Director of Content to assess editorial capacity, staffing needs, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

### **Minimum Requirements**

Knowledge equivalent to that which normally would be acquired by completing a four-year college degree program in Journalism, Telecommunications, Marketing, Advertising, Public Relations, or related field; three to five years of related and progressively more responsible or expansive work experience in public and media relations; composing, editing and publication production; news, broadcasting, and print media; and/or marketing, advertising, and creative services; graphic design; word processing; desktop publishing; web design; presentation; spreadsheet and/or database software; public presentation or radio production; or computer programming/technology; and/or experience in a field related to are of employment; may require management and supervisory experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

### **Desired Qualifications**

* Experience supervising, coaching and developing writers, editors, students, or other communications staff.
* Experience serving as editor or senior editorial lead for a magazine, newsletter, website, newsroom, or other recurring publication.
* Demonstrated excellence in professional writing and storytelling, along with significant editing, copy editing, and proofreading experience and a strong command of grammar, style, and editorial judgment.
* Strong knowledge of AP style, editorial quality-control practices, accessibility standards, and inclusive communications practices.
* Understanding of integrated marketing and communications practices across web, email, print, social media, video, and other channels.
* Ability to work effectively with subject-matter experts, campus communicators, and organizational leaders to develop clear, compelling content.
* Experience establishing editorial processes, style resources, documentation, or training that improve consistency and quality.
* Strong judgment, attention to detail, curiosity, and ability to balance strategic priorities with day-to-day editorial needs.
* Experience working in higher education, advancement, nonprofit, journalism, agency, or another complex, mission-driven organization.

### **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, age, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Art & Animation Director
description:
**About the Role**

IllFonic is seeking an Art & Animation Director to oversee the artistic direction, visual quality, and multidisciplinary art and animation teams for an exciting new title. In this role, you will lead and unify visual vision across Environment Art, Tech Art, Outsourcing, VFX, Tech Animation, Animation, Lighting, Characters, UI/UX, and Concept Art departments. You will work closely with the Chief Creative Officer, Design, and Engineering to establish cohesive, high-fidelity art styles, optimize real-time production pipelines, and mentor creative talent to ship immersive game experiences.

**About the Company**

Founded in 2007, IllFonic is an independent video game developer and publisher with studios in Lakewood, Colorado and Tacoma, Washington. Our staff is composed of video game, music, and technology veterans redefining how indie and middle-market games are made and marketed. Current and past titles / collaborations include Halloween: The Game, Killer Klowns from Outer Space: The Game, Ghostbusters: Spirits Unleashed, Arcadegeddon, Predator: Hunting Grounds, Friday the 13th: The Game, Dead Alliance, Star Citizen, Evolve, Armored Warfare, and Nexuiz.

**Responsibilities**

* Define and maintain cohesive, high-fidelity visual styles and artistic direction across all game assets and disciplines
* Provide high-level creative direction and leadership across Environment, Tech Art, Outsourcing, VFX, Tech Animation, Animation, Lighting, Characters, UI/UX, and Concept Art teams
* Partner with Chief Creative Officer, Design Leads, and Engineering to unify creative vision with gameplay and technical goals
* Manage, mentor, and guide art leads and individual artists, fostering professional growth and strong team culture
* Evaluate and optimize art production pipelines and workflows to improve efficiency, performance, and asset quality
* Oversee external art outsourcing partners and asset leads to ensure visual consistency and high visual fidelity
* Collaborate to establish art benchmarks, visual target renders, and style guides for internal and external development
* Actively review and critique real-time lighting, shaders, environments, character models, animations, and visual effects in engine
* Participate in hiring, staffing plan reviews, and resource allocation across Art and Animation departments

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of professional experience in video game art production, with 5+ years in Art Director roles
* Multiple shipped console and PC titles as an Art Director
* Proven track record leading multidisciplinary teams of artists across characters, environments, lighting, animation, and VFX
* Expert understanding of 3D modeling, sculpting, texturing, animation, lighting, and real-time engine workflows (ZBrush, Maya, 3ds Max, Substance Painter, Photoshop, Unreal Engine)
* Demonstrated expertise in building and streamlining art pipelines for high-fidelity real-time rendering
* Experience directing persistent world or live-service visual content and world building
* Strong portfolio/artstation demonstrating exceptional visual benchmark creation, character/environment design, and creative vision

**Cultural Fit**

* Collaborative leader who thrives in cross-functional team environments
* Passionate mentor dedicated to developing artist talent and raising team quality standards
* Resourceful problem solver with a hands-on approach to artistic and technical pipeline challenges
* Excellent communicator capable of inspiring artists and aligning multi-discipline stakeholders

**Bonus**

* Prior experience working with and expanding existing intellectual property
* Deep familiarity with Unreal Engine

title: Director, Product Design
description:
****🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!****
Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.
  
  
As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.
  
  
We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a strategic and inspiring Director of Product Design to lead our Buyer Design team, the group responsible for shaping the end-to-end experience for millions of users navigating our platform.
  
  
As the design leader overseeing the entire buyer journey, you'll drive the strategy and execution for everything from customer acquisition, activation, to retention and re-engagement. This includes onboarding, discovery surfaces (browse, search, ranking, personalization, taxonomy), the live shopping experience, customer service, our games team, and customer service flows.
  
  
You’ll be a true player-coach, equally comfortable building and developing a high-performing design team as you are rolling up your sleeves and doing the work yourself. You’ll help shape the team, establish clear career paths, mentor designers, and create an environment where people can grow and do their best work.
  
  
As a leader, you’ll help define the design strategy and set a clear vision for what our experiences can become, partnering closely with product, engineering, research, and business teams to turn that vision into a roadmap for the team.
  
  
As a practitioner, you’ll stay close to the work. You’ll move fluidly from defining the long-term experience vision to tackling specific product and feature-level design challenges - exploring concepts, prototyping ideas, and helping bring the details to life. This role is for someone who can lead through both direction and craft, knowing when to empower the team and when to jump in and design alongside them.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and scale a high-performing team of product designers across the buyer funnel.
* Define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the buyer experience in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
* Partner with research, data, and product to develop deep customer empathy and inform high-impact design decisions.
* Shape intuitive, elegant systems across discovery, live shopping, and post-purchase experiences.
* Ensure our experiences are accessible, inclusive, and delightfully human.
* Champion design quality and consistency across surfaces while enabling speed and iteration.
* Nurture a strong design culture through mentorship, feedback, and high standards for craft and thinking.
* Represent design in executive conversations and influence company-wide priorities.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years leading teams.
* A player-coach mindset-excited to mentor, but equally passionate about designing and solving problems hands-on.
* Strong portfolio showcasing interaction and visual design skills, with a track record of shipping successful products.
* Proven success designing and scaling customer-facing experiences across a complex funnel (acquisition through retention).
* Deep expertise in interaction design, systems thinking, and user-centered design.
* Strong understanding of search, discovery, personalization, and taxonomy design principles.
* Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, or live shopping platforms is a major plus.
* A strong collaborator who thrives at the intersection of product, business, and user needs.
* A portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, elegant solutions to complex problems.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**
You’ll help define how the next generation of users discover, shop, and engage with sellers and communities they love. You’ll work alongside a passionate and ambitious team that values joy, experimentation, and deep customer empathy. And you’ll help build a design culture where creativity and performance go hand in hand.
  
  
If you’re an experienced design leader who loves craft, strategy, and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
****Reporting Structure****
Jon Malkemus - VP of Design

We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce.
